edition_zh: 王弼本（華亭張氏原本），中文維基文庫
edition_en: Wang Bi text; English by James Legge, 1891

lines: 道可道非常道名可名非常名
無名天地之始有名萬物之母
此兩者同出而異名同謂之玄
chapters.translation_en: The Tao that can be trodden is not the enduring and unchanging Tao. The name that can be named is not the enduring and unchanging name.

en.plain: The plan for your life keeps changing, and every name you give it stops fitting within a month.
en.story:
The first chapter refuses to define its own subject. The way that can be walked is not the lasting way; the name that can be named is not the lasting name. Laozi is not being mysterious for its own sake. He is warning against the habit of mistaking the label for the thing.

A job title, a relationship status, a five-year plan: each is a name, useful for a while, and each stops fitting. When it stops fitting, the temptation is to think something has gone wrong with the life. The chapter suggests the opposite: the name was always going to run out, because the thing it pointed at was alive. Look at what is actually there, before the name, and let the name be replaced without alarm.
en.reminder: The name runs out; the thing goes on.
en.acting: Write down what you are actually doing this month, in plain words, without a title.

zh_hant.plain: 人生的計畫一直在變，你給它取的每一個名字，不到一個月就不合身了。
zh_hant.story:
第一章拒絕定義自己的主題。走得出來的道，不是恆常的道；叫得出來的名，不是恆常的名。老子不是故弄玄虛。他在提醒一種習慣：把標籤當成東西本身。

一個職稱、一段關係的狀態、一份五年計畫：每一個都是名字，一陣子有用，然後每一個都不再合身。不合身的時候，人很容易覺得是人生出了問題。這一章說的正好相反：名字本來就會用完，因為它指著的那樣東西是活的。看看名字底下真正在那裡的東西，讓名字換掉，不必驚慌。
zh_hant.reminder: 名字會用完；事情繼續走。
zh_hant.acting: 用最平常的話，寫下你這個月真正在做的事，不加頭銜。

zh_hans.plain: 人生的计划一直在变，你给它取的每一个名字，不到一个月就不合身了。
zh_hans.story:
第一章拒绝定义自己的主题。走得出来的道，不是恒常的道；叫得出来的名，不是恒常的名。老子不是故弄玄虚。他在提醒一种习惯：把标签当成东西本身。

一个职称、一段关系的状态、一份五年计划：每一个都是名字，一阵子有用，然后每一个都不再合身。不合身的时候，人很容易觉得是人生出了问题。这一章说的正好相反：名字本来就会用完，因为它指着的那样东西是活的。看看名字底下真正在那里的东西，让名字换掉，不必惊慌。
zh_hans.reminder: 名字会用完；事情继续走。
zh_hans.acting: 用最平常的话，写下你这个月真正在做的事，不加头衔。

lines: 天下皆知美之為美斯惡已
皆知善之為善斯不善已
長短相較高下相傾音聲相和
萬物作焉而不辭生而不有
chapters.translation_en: (Conceived of as) having no name, it is the Originator of heaven and earth; (conceived of as) having a name, it is the Mother of all things.

en.plain: You spent the week comparing: better paid, worse paid, nicer flat, smaller flat, and the comparing left you tired.
en.story:
Everyone knows beauty by comparison with ugliness, Laozi says, and good by comparison with what is not good. Long and short, high and low, before and after: each exists only because of the other. The sage therefore acts without straining and teaches without lecturing, lets things grow without owning them, does the work and does not sit on the credit.

Comparison is not a sin; it is how the mind sees. The chapter's point is smaller and more useful. The two sides of every comparison are made together, so no amount of climbing one side ever removes the other. There is always a nicer flat. The tiredness comes from treating that as a problem to be solved rather than a fact about pairs. Do the work in front of you, let it stand, and the pairs can go on pairing without you.
en.reminder: Every pair is made together; climbing one side keeps the other.
en.acting: Finish one piece of work today and leave it without measuring it against anyone.

zh_hant.plain: 這一週你一直在比：薪水高的、薪水低的，房子好的、房子小的，比到累。
zh_hant.story:
老子說，人知道什麼是美，是因為有醜對照；知道什麼是好，是因為有不好。長短、高低、前後，每一樣都因為另一樣才存在。所以聖人做事不硬撐，教人不說教，讓萬物生長而不佔有，做了事而不坐在功勞上。

比較不是罪，那是心看東西的方式。這一章的重點更小、也更有用。每一組比較的兩邊是一起造出來的，所以不管往其中一邊爬多高，另一邊都不會消失。永遠有更好的房子。累，是因為把這件事當成要解決的問題，而不是關於「成對」的事實。把眼前的事做完，讓它站著，那些成對的東西可以自己繼續成對，不必你參與。
zh_hant.reminder: 每一對都是一起造出來的；爬上一邊，另一邊還在。
zh_hant.acting: 今天做完一件事，放著，不拿它跟任何人比。

zh_hans.plain: 这一周你一直在比：薪水高的、薪水低的，房子好的、房子小的，比到累。
zh_hans.story:
老子说，人知道什么是美，是因为有丑对照；知道什么是好，是因为有不好。长短、高低、前后，每一样都因为另一样才存在。所以圣人做事不硬撑，教人不说教，让万物生长而不占有，做了事而不坐在功劳上。

比较不是罪，那是心看东西的方式。这一章的重点更小、也更有用。每一组比较的两边是一起造出来的，所以不管往其中一边爬多高，另一边都不会消失。永远有更好的房子。累，是因为把这件事当成要解决的问题，而不是关于「成对」的事实。把眼前的事做完，让它站着，那些成对的东西可以自己继续成对，不必你参与。
zh_hans.reminder: 每一对都是一起造出来的；爬上一边，另一边还在。
zh_hans.acting: 今天做完一件事，放着，不拿它跟任何人比。

lines: 不貴難得之貨使民不為盜
是以聖人之治虛其心實其腹
chapters.translation_en:
Always without desire we must be found,
 If its deep mystery we would sound;
 But if desire always within us be,
 Its outer fringe is all that we shall see.

en.plain: Prices for the things everyone wants keep rising, and wanting them is wearing you down.
en.story:
Laozi's advice to rulers here is to stop parading the rare and the desirable in front of people, because a mind kept full of what it does not have cannot rest. Fill the belly, he says; empty the striving.

Nobody governs a country from a kitchen table, but the chapter reads well at one. The parade of the desirable now arrives by phone, and the wanting it produces is not a weakness of character; it is what the parade is for. The chapter's counter is physical. Eat properly. Sleep. Keep the body's needs met and let the appetite for the rare things go quiet from lack of feeding. It is not a cure for high prices. It is a way to stop paying for them twice, once in money and once in wanting.
en.reminder: Fill the belly; let the striving go quiet.
en.acting: Cook one proper meal today and eat it away from the phone.

zh_hant.plain: 大家都想要的東西一直漲價，想要它們這件事本身，正在磨掉你。
zh_hant.story:
老子在這裡給君王的建議，是別把稀有的、令人想要的東西擺在人面前，因為一顆一直裝著「沒有的東西」的心，靜不下來。他說，把肚子填飽，把爭競放空。

沒有人在廚房餐桌上治國，但這一章在餐桌上讀起來剛好。令人想要的東西現在由手機送來，它製造的想要不是性格的弱點，那正是那場展示的目的。這一章的對策是身體的。好好吃飯。睡覺。讓身體的需要被滿足，讓對稀有東西的胃口因為沒有被餵而安靜下來。這治不了高物價。它是一種辦法，讓你不必為它付兩次錢，一次是錢，一次是想要。
zh_hant.reminder: 把肚子填飽；讓爭競安靜下來。
zh_hant.acting: 今天好好煮一頓飯，離開手機吃。

zh_hans.plain: 大家都想要的东西一直涨价，想要它们这件事本身，正在磨掉你。
zh_hans.story:
老子在这里给君王的建议，是别把稀有的、令人想要的东西摆在人面前，因为一颗一直装着「没有的东西」的心，静不下来。他说，把肚子填饱，把争竞放空。

没有人在厨房餐桌上治国，但这一章在餐桌上读起来刚好。令人想要的东西现在由手机送来，它制造的想要不是性格的弱点，那正是那场展示的目的。这一章的对策是身体的。好好吃饭。睡觉。让身体的需要被满足，让对稀有东西的胃口因为没有被喂而安静下来。这治不了高物价。它是一种办法，让你不必为它付两次钱，一次是钱，一次是想要。
zh_hans.reminder: 把肚子填饱；让争竞安静下来。
zh_hans.acting: 今天好好煮一顿饭，离开手机吃。

lines: 挫其銳解其紛和其光同其塵
吾不知誰之子象帝之先
chapters.translation_en:
Under these two aspects, it is really the same; but as development takes place, it receives the different names. Together we call them the Mystery. Where the Mystery is the deepest is the gate of all that is subtle and wonderful.
1. All in the world know the beauty of the beautiful, and in doing this they have (the idea of) what ugliness is; they all know the skill of the skilful, and in doing this they have (the idea of) what the want of skill is.
So it is that existence and non-existence give birth the one to (the idea of) the other; that difficulty and ease produce the one (the idea of) the other; that length and shortness fashion out the one the figure of the other; that (the ideas of) height and lowness arise from the contrast of the one with the other; that the musical notes and tones become harmonious through the relation of one with another; and that being before and behind give the idea of one following another.
Therefore the sage manages affairs without doing anything, and conveys his instructions without the use of speech.
All things spring up, and there is not one which declines to show itself; they grow, and there is no claim made for their ownership; they go through their processes, and there is no expectation (of a reward for the results). The work is accomplished, and there is no resting in it (as an achievement).
 The work is done, but how no one can see;
 'Tis this that makes the power not cease to be.
1. Not to value and employ men of superior ability is the way to keep the people from rivalry among themselves; not to prize articles which are difficult to procure is the way to keep them from becoming thieves; not to show them what is likely to excite their desires is the way to keep their minds from disorder.
Therefore the sage, in the exercise of his government, empties their minds, fills their bellies, weakens their wills, and strengthens their bones.
He constantly (tries to) keep them without knowledge and without desire, and where there are those who have knowledge, to keep them from presuming to act (on it). When there is this abstinence from action, good order is universal.
1. The Tao is (like) the emptiness of a vessel; and in our employment of it we must be on our guard against all fulness. How deep and unfathomable it is, as if it were the Honoured Ancestor of all things!
We should blunt our sharp points, and unravel the complications of things; we should attemper our brightness, and bring ourselves into agreement with the obscurity of others. How pure and still the Tao is, as if it would ever so continue!
I do not know whose son it is. It might appear to have been before
God.

en.plain: You have been asked to be the calm one at home and at work, and you feel empty from it.
en.story:
The Tao is like a vessel that is used and never filled, Laozi says; it is deep, and it blunts sharpness, untangles knots, softens glare, and settles into the dust with everything else. It seems to have been there before anything.

Being the calm one is a kind of emptiness people rely on, and it costs something. The chapter does not say the cost is imaginary. It describes the same emptiness from the inside: the vessel is not drained by use because it was never holding its contents as possessions. Blunting the sharp remark at dinner, untangling the misunderstanding at work, standing in the same dust as everyone: these are what the empty vessel does, and it goes on doing them because it has stopped keeping a tally of how much each one took.
en.reminder: The vessel is used and not emptied.
en.acting: Untangle one knot for someone today, and do not add it to a tally.

zh_hant.plain: 家裡和公司都要你當那個最冷靜的人，你已經被掏空了。
zh_hant.story:
老子說，道像一個用了卻永遠裝不滿的器皿；它很深，它挫掉銳利，解開糾纏，柔和刺眼的光，跟萬物一起落在塵土裡。它好像在一切之前就在那裡了。

當那個冷靜的人，是一種被大家倚靠的「空」，它是有代價的。這一章沒有說代價是假的。它從裡面描述同一種空：器皿不會因為被用而耗盡，因為它從來沒有把裝的東西當成自己的財產。把晚餐桌上尖銳的話磨鈍，把公司裡的誤會解開，跟大家站在同一片塵土裡：這些就是空的器皿在做的事，而它能一直做，是因為它不再記每一件花了多少。
zh_hant.reminder: 器皿被用，不被掏空。
zh_hant.acting: 今天替一個人解開一個結，然後不把它記在帳上。

zh_hans.plain: 家里和公司都要你当那个最冷静的人，你已经被掏空了。
zh_hans.story:
老子说，道像一个用了却永远装不满的器皿；它很深，它挫掉锐利，解开纠缠，柔和刺眼的光，跟万物一起落在尘土里。它好像在一切之前就在那里了。

当那个冷静的人，是一种被大家倚靠的「空」，它是有代价的。这一章没有说代价是假的。它从里面描述同一种空：器皿不会因为被用而耗尽，因为它从来没有把装的东西当成自己的财产。把晚餐桌上尖锐的话磨钝，把公司里的误会解开，跟大家站在同一片尘土里：这些就是空的器皿在做的事，而它能一直做，是因为它不再记每一件花了多少。
zh_hans.reminder: 器皿被用，不被掏空。
zh_hans.acting: 今天替一个人解开一个结，然后不把它记在帐上。

lines: 天地不仁以萬物為芻狗
聖人不仁以百姓為芻狗

en.plain: Nobody at the office or in the family seems to notice how hard you are trying, and the indifference stings.
en.story:
Heaven and earth are not kind, Laozi says: they treat everything like the straw dogs used in ceremonies, honoured for a day and discarded. The space between heaven and earth is like a bellows: empty, and the more it moves the more comes out. Many words wear out; better to hold the centre.

The first sentence sounds cold and is meant as relief. The world's indifference to your effort is not a judgement on the effort. Rain falls on the careful gardener and the careless one alike. Once that is accepted, a great deal of energy that was going into being noticed is freed for the work itself. The bellows image is the practical part: the empty middle is where the air comes from. Say less. Hold the centre. The effort continues; the audience was never the point.
en.reminder: The world is not watching; the work is still yours.
en.acting: Do the next piece of work as if nobody will see it, because that is already true.

zh_hant.plain: 公司裡和家裡好像沒有人注意到你有多努力，那種冷淡刺人。
zh_hant.story:
老子說，天地不仁：它對待萬物像祭典上的芻狗，供奉一天就丟。天地之間像一個風箱：空的，動得越多，出來的越多。話多了會耗盡，不如守住中間。

第一句聽起來冷，其實是一種鬆開。世界對你的努力無動於衷，不是對努力的評價。雨落在細心的園丁身上，也落在粗心的園丁身上。接受了這件事，原本花在「被看見」上的大量力氣，就回到工作本身。風箱是實際的部分：空的中間，正是氣出來的地方。少說。守住中間。努力繼續，觀眾從來不是重點。
zh_hant.reminder: 世界沒有在看；工作還是你的。
zh_hant.acting: 把下一件事當成沒有人會看見來做，因為本來就是這樣。

zh_hans.plain: 公司里和家里好像没有人注意到你有多努力，那种冷淡刺人。
zh_hans.story:
老子说，天地不仁：它对待万物像祭典上的刍狗，供奉一天就丢。天地之间像一个风箱：空的，动得越多，出来的越多。话多了会耗尽，不如守住中间。

第一句听起来冷，其实是一种松开。世界对你的努力无动于衷，不是对努力的评价。雨落在细心的园丁身上，也落在粗心的园丁身上。接受了这件事，原本花在「被看见」上的大量力气，就回到工作本身。风箱是实际的部分：空的中间，正是气出来的地方。少说。守住中间。努力继续，观众从来不是重点。
zh_hans.reminder: 世界没有在看；工作还是你的。
zh_hans.acting: 把下一件事当成没有人会看见来做，因为本来就是这样。

chapters.translation_en:
The valley spirit dies not, aye the same;
 The female mystery thus do we name.
 Its gate, from which at first they issued forth,
 Is called the root from which grew heaven and earth.
 Long and unbroken does its power remain,
 Used gently, and without the touch of pain.

en.plain: You have given so much to children, parents or colleagues that the giving feels close to empty.
en.story:
The valley spirit never dies, Laozi says; call it the mysterious female. Its gate is the root of heaven and earth. It goes on and on, seeming always there, and its use is never exhausted.

The valley is the low place that receives every stream and is not emptied by giving them onward. The chapter's female is not a comment on women; it is the image of what receives and produces without running dry. For someone who has been giving to children or parents for years, the fear is that the well has a bottom. The chapter says the valley's source is the lowness itself: it fills because it is low. Rest is not the opposite of giving here. It is the receiving half of the same movement, and it is owed.
en.reminder: The valley fills because it is low.
en.acting: Take the low place today: let someone do one thing for you, and accept it.

zh_hant.plain: 你給孩子、父母或同事的已經太多，多到給這件事快要空了。
zh_hant.story:
老子說，谷神不死，把它叫做玄牝。它的門，是天地的根。它綿綿不絕，好像一直在，用起來不會竭盡。

山谷是低處，接住每一條溪，把它們送往下游也不會空。這一章的「牝」不是在說女性；它是「接受並生產而不乾涸」的圖像。給孩子或父母給了好幾年的人，害怕的是井有底。這一章說，山谷的源頭就是低本身：因為低，所以滿。在這裡，休息不是給的反面。它是同一個動作裡接受的那一半，而且是應得的。
zh_hant.reminder: 山谷因為低，所以滿。
zh_hant.acting: 今天站到低處：讓一個人為你做一件事，然後接受它。

zh_hans.plain: 你给孩子、父母或同事的已经太多，多到给这件事快要空了。
zh_hans.story:
老子说，谷神不死，把它叫做玄牝。它的门，是天地的根。它绵绵不绝，好像一直在，用起来不会竭尽。

山谷是低处，接住每一条溪，把它们送往下游也不会空。这一章的「牝」不是在说女性；它是「接受并生产而不干涸」的图像。给孩子或父母给了好几年的人，害怕的是井有底。这一章说，山谷的源头就是低本身：因为低，所以满。在这里，休息不是给的反面。它是同一个动作里接受的那一半，而且是应得的。
zh_hans.reminder: 山谷因为低，所以满。
zh_hans.acting: 今天站到低处：让一个人为你做一件事，然后接受它。

lines: 是以聖人後其身而身先
非以其無私邪故能成其私
chapters.translation_en:
Heaven is long-enduring and earth continues long. The reason why heaven and earth are able to endure and continue thus long is because they do not live of, or for, themselves. This is how they are able to continue and endure.
Therefore the sage puts his own person last, and yet it is found in the foremost place; he treats his person as if it were foreign to him, and yet that person is preserved. Is it not because he has no personal and private ends, that therefore such ends are realised?

en.plain: You put yourself last every day, and it is starting to feel like disappearing.
en.story:
Heaven and earth last long because they do not live for themselves, Laozi says. So the sage puts himself last and finds himself first, treats himself as an outsider and is preserved. Is it not because he has no private ends that his private ends are met?

This chapter is quoted at people who already put themselves last, and it needs reading carefully. Laozi's sage is not disappearing; he is preserved. The self that is put last is the anxious, grasping one, the one that keeps a ledger. What remains when that self steps back is not nothing. It is the person who can be useful without being consumed, because the usefulness is no longer a bid for something. If putting yourself last feels like vanishing, the ledger is still running. Close it, and the same acts stop costing.
en.reminder: Put the grasping self last; the rest of you stays.
en.acting: Do one thing today for yourself alone, and count it as part of the work.

zh_hant.plain: 你每天都把自己放在最後，開始覺得自己快要消失。
zh_hant.story:
老子說，天地長久，是因為它們不為自己活。所以聖人把自己放在後面，反而在前面；把自己當外人，反而保全了。不正是因為他沒有私心，私心才得到成全嗎？

這一章常被拿來對已經把自己放最後的人說，需要小心讀。老子的聖人沒有消失；他被保全了。被放在後面的那個「自己」，是焦慮的、抓取的、記帳的那一個。那個自己退後之後，剩下的不是空。剩下的是一個能有用而不被耗盡的人，因為有用不再是為了換什麼。如果把自己放最後讓你覺得快要消失，那本帳還在算。把它合上，同樣的事就不再花錢。
zh_hant.reminder: 把抓取的自己放到後面；其餘的你還在。
zh_hant.acting: 今天為自己一個人做一件事，把它算進工作裡。

zh_hans.plain: 你每天都把自己放在最后，开始觉得自己快要消失。
zh_hans.story:
老子说，天地长久，是因为它们不为自己活。所以圣人把自己放在后面，反而在前面；把自己当外人，反而保全了。不正是因为他没有私心，私心才得到成全吗？

这一章常被拿来对已经把自己放最后的人说，需要小心读。老子的圣人没有消失；他被保全了。被放在后面的那个「自己」，是焦虑的、抓取的、记帐的那一个。那个自己退后之后，剩下的不是空。剩下的是一个能有用而不被耗尽的人，因为有用不再是为了换什么。如果把自己放最后让你觉得快要消失，那本帐还在算。把它合上，同样的事就不再花钱。
zh_hans.reminder: 把抓取的自己放到后面；其余的你还在。
zh_hans.acting: 今天为自己一个人做一件事，把它算进工作里。

lines: 居善地心善淵與善仁言善信
chapters.translation_en:
The highest excellence is like (that of) water. The excellence of water appears in its benefiting all things, and in its occupying, without striving (to the contrary), the low place which all men dislike. Hence (its way) is near to (that of) the Tao.
The excellence of a residence is in (the suitability of) the place; that of the mind is in abysmal stillness; that of associations is in their being with the virtuous; that of government is in its securing good order; that of (the conduct of) affairs is in its ability; and that of (the initiation of) any movement is in its timeliness.
And when (one with the highest excellence) does not wrangle (about his low position), no one finds fault with him.

en.plain: The rent is due, the boss is short with you, and there is no fight left in you for either.
en.story:
The highest good is like water, which benefits everything and does not contend, and settles in the low places people avoid. Laozi then lists where excellence lives: in a home, its position; in a mind, its depth; in dealings, kindness; in speech, truth; in work, competence; in action, timing. Because water does not contend, nothing contends with it.

Water's method is to go around, to go under, or to wait. On a month when the money is short and the messages keep coming, the instinct is to push back on everything at once and be empty by Thursday. The chapter proposes a different order: take the low place on purpose, do the one thing that can be done, and let the rest arrive in its time. The rent is still paid. The answer is still given. The force comes from patience and direction rather than from bracing.
en.reminder: Take the low place, then keep flowing.
en.acting: Pay the one bill you can pay today, and answer the one message that matters.

zh_hant.plain: 房租快到期，主管口氣很衝，而你已經沒有力氣跟這兩件事對抗。
zh_hant.story:
上善若水：水滋潤萬物而不爭，停在人不願去的低處。接著老子列出「善」住在哪裡：住處在於位置，心在於深，交往在於仁，說話在於信，做事在於能，行動在於時機。因為水不爭，所以沒有東西跟它爭。

水的辦法是繞過去、從底下過去，或者等。在錢不夠、訊息一直進來的月份，本能是一次頂回去，然後星期四就空了。這一章提議另一種順序：刻意站在低處，做那一件做得到的事，其餘的讓它按時到來。房租照樣付。回覆照樣給。力氣來自耐心和方向，不是來自硬撐。
zh_hant.reminder: 先站到低處，然後繼續流。
zh_hant.acting: 今天先付那一張付得出的帳單，先回那一則最要緊的訊息。

zh_hans.plain: 房租快到期，主管口气很冲，而你已经没有力气跟这两件事对抗。
zh_hans.story:
上善若水：水滋润万物而不争，停在人不愿去的低处。接着老子列出「善」住在哪里：住处在于位置，心在于深，交往在于仁，说话在于信，做事在于能，行动在于时机。因为水不争，所以没有东西跟它争。

水的办法是绕过去、从底下过去，或者等。在钱不够、消息一直进来的月份，本能是一次顶回去，然后星期四就空了。这一章提议另一种顺序：刻意站在低处，做那一件做得到的事，其余的让它按时到来。房租照样付。回复照样给。力气来自耐心和方向，不是来自硬撑。
zh_hans.reminder: 先站到低处，然后继续流。
zh_hans.acting: 今天先付那一张付得出的帐单，先回那一则最要紧的消息。

chapters.translation_en:
It is better to leave a vessel unfilled, than to attempt to carry it when it is full. If you keep feeling a point that has been sharpened, the point cannot long preserve its sharpness.
When gold and jade fill the hall, their possessor cannot keep them safe. When wealth and honours lead to arrogancy, this brings its evil on itself. When the work is done, and one's name is becoming distinguished, to withdraw into obscurity is the way of Heaven.

en.plain: The bonus, the title, the bigger flat: you got the thing you were chasing and cannot stop chasing.
en.story:
Better to stop than to fill a vessel to the brim, Laozi says. Sharpen a blade too far and it will not keep its edge. A hall full of gold cannot be guarded. Wealth and rank that breed pride bring their own trouble. When the work is done, withdraw: that is the way of heaven.

The chapter is about the moment after getting what you wanted. The bonus arrived and the next target appeared before it was spent; the title came and the one above it started to itch. That itch is not greed. It is what a mind trained on targets does when a target disappears. The counsel is to notice the brim. Enough is a place, and it is possible to stand on it for a while before deciding whether to move. Withdrawing after the work is done is not quitting; it is letting the thing be finished.
en.reminder: When the work is done, step back and let it be finished.
en.acting: Name one thing you have already reached, and give it a week before the next target.

zh_hant.plain: 獎金、頭銜、更大的房子：你追到了，卻停不下來繼續追。
zh_hant.story:
老子說，與其把器皿裝到滿溢，不如停下。刀磨得太過，鋒利保不住。滿屋子的金，守不住。財富和地位帶來驕傲，就帶來自己的麻煩。事情做完了就退下：這是天的方式。

這一章講的是「得到想要的東西」之後的那一刻。獎金到了，還沒花，下一個目標就出現；頭銜來了，上面那一個開始癢。那種癢不是貪。那是一顆被目標訓練過的心，在目標消失時會做的事。這裡的建議是注意杯緣。「夠了」是一個地方，可以先站在上面一陣子，再決定要不要動。事情做完就退下，不是放棄；是讓它真的完成。
zh_hant.reminder: 事情做完了，退一步，讓它完成。
zh_hant.acting: 說出一件你已經到達的事，在下一個目標之前，給它一個星期。

zh_hans.plain: 奖金、头衔、更大的房子：你追到了，却停不下来继续追。
zh_hans.story:
老子说，与其把器皿装到满溢，不如停下。刀磨得太过，锋利保不住。满屋子的金，守不住。财富和地位带来骄傲，就带来自己的麻烦。事情做完了就退下：这是天的方式。

这一章讲的是「得到想要的东西」之后的那一刻。奖金到了，还没花，下一个目标就出现；头衔来了，上面那一个开始痒。那种痒不是贪。那是一颗被目标训练过的心，在目标消失时会做的事。这里的建议是注意杯缘。「够了」是一个地方，可以先站在上面一阵子，再决定要不要动。事情做完就退下，不是放弃；是让它真的完成。
zh_hans.reminder: 事情做完了，退一步，让它完成。
zh_hans.acting: 说出一件你已经到达的事，在下一个目标之前，给它一个星期。

lines: 生而不有為而不恃長而不宰
chapters.translation_en:
When the intelligent and animal souls are held together in one embrace, they can be kept from separating. When one gives undivided attention to the (vital) breath, and brings it to the utmost degree of pliancy, he can become as a (tender) babe. When he has cleansed away the most mysterious sights (of his imagination), he can become without a flaw.
In loving the people and ruling the state, cannot he proceed without any (purpose of) action? In the opening and shutting of his gates of heaven, cannot he do so as a female bird? While his intelligence reaches in every direction, cannot he (appear to) be without knowledge? (The Tao) produces (all things) and nourishes them; it produces them and does not claim them as its own; it does all, and yet does not boast of it; it presides over all, and yet does not control them.
This is what is called 'The mysterious Quality' (of the Tao).

en.plain: You are trying to hold a family, a job and a body together at once, and everything wobbles.
en.story:
Can you hold body and spirit together without their coming apart? Can you breathe as softly as an infant? Can you clean the inner mirror until it has no spot? Can you love people and lead without cleverness? Laozi's chapter is a set of questions, and it ends with the same rule as before: produce, nourish, do not possess, do not lean on the doing.

The questions are not a test. They describe what holding many things together feels like from inside when it is going well: soft breath, a clean mirror, love that does not need to be clever. The wobble comes from gripping. The family does not need to be gripped; it needs to be fed and let grow. Same for the job, and the body. The chapter's last line is the release: do the holding, and do not lean your weight on it.
en.reminder: Hold it softly; do not lean your weight on it.
en.acting: Loosen your grip on one thing today: delegate, delay, or simply let it be.

zh_hant.plain: 你想同時把家、工作和身體撐住，每一樣都在晃。
zh_hant.story:
能不能讓身和魂抱在一起而不分開？能不能呼吸得像嬰兒那樣柔軟？能不能把心裡的鏡子擦到沒有一點污？能不能愛人、治理而不用聰明？老子這一章是一連串問句，結尾還是同一條規矩：生出來、養育、不佔有、不倚仗。

這些問句不是考試。它們描述的是同時撐著很多東西、而且撐得好的時候，從裡面感覺到的樣子：柔軟的呼吸，乾淨的鏡子，不需要聰明的愛。晃，來自抓。家不需要被抓，它需要被餵養、被允許生長。工作也是，身體也是。這一章最後一句是鬆開：撐著，但別把體重靠上去。
zh_hant.reminder: 輕輕地抱著；別把體重靠上去。
zh_hant.acting: 今天對一件事鬆手：交出去、延後、或就讓它那樣。

zh_hans.plain: 你想同时把家、工作和身体撑住，每一样都在晃。
zh_hans.story:
能不能让身和魂抱在一起而不分开？能不能呼吸得像婴儿那样柔软？能不能把心里的镜子擦到没有一点污？能不能爱人、治理而不用聪明？老子这一章是一连串问句，结尾还是同一条规矩：生出来、养育、不占有、不倚仗。

这些问句不是考试。它们描述的是同时撑着很多东西、而且撑得好的时候，从里面感觉到的样子：柔软的呼吸，干净的镜子，不需要聪明的爱。晃，来自抓。家不需要被抓，它需要被喂养、被允许生长。工作也是，身体也是。这一章最后一句是松开：撑着，但别把体重靠上去。
zh_hans.reminder: 轻轻地抱着；别把体重靠上去。
zh_hans.acting: 今天对一件事松手：交出去、延后、或就让它那样。

lines: 埏埴以為器當其無有器之用
故有之以為利無之以為用
chapters.translation_en: The thirty spokes unite in the one nave; but it is on the empty space (for the axle), that the use of the wheel depends. Clay is fashioned into vessels; but it is on their empty hollowness, that their use depends. The door and windows are cut out (from the walls) to form an apartment; but it is on the empty space (within), that its use depends. Therefore, what has a (positive) existence serves for profitable adaptation, and what has not that for (actual) usefulness.

en.plain: You keep filling every free hour, and the days have no room left in them.
en.story:
Thirty spokes share one hub, and it is the empty space at the centre that makes the wheel useful. Clay is shaped into a pot, and the pot's use is the hollow. Doors and windows are cut from walls, and the room is the space inside. What is there gives the thing its form; what is not there gives it its use.

This is the chapter for a full calendar. A week with every hour filled is a pot with no hollow: solid, heavy, and useless for holding anything. Empty hours are not laziness, they are the part that works. The chapter does not tell anyone to do less; it says that the doing needs the not-doing the way a wheel needs a hub. Leave the hollow in the day on purpose, and the day carries more.
en.reminder: The hollow is the part that works.
en.acting: Cross one thing off tomorrow's list and leave the hour empty.

zh_hant.plain: 你把每一個空出來的小時都填滿，日子裡再也沒有空間。
zh_hant.story:
三十根輻條共用一個轂，是中間的空讓輪子有用。泥做成器皿，器皿的用處是那個空。牆上開了門窗，房間是裡面的空。有的東西給了形狀；沒有的東西給了用處。

這是給排滿的行事曆的一章。每個小時都填滿的一週，是一個沒有空腔的器皿：實心、沉重，什麼也裝不了。空出來的小時不是懶，它們是會工作的那部分。這一章沒有叫誰少做；它說做需要不做，像輪子需要轂。刻意把空腔留在日子裡，日子能裝的反而更多。
zh_hant.reminder: 空的那部分，才是有用的部分。
zh_hant.acting: 把明天清單上的一件事劃掉，讓那個小時空著。

zh_hans.plain: 你把每一个空出来的小时都填满，日子里再也没有空间。
zh_hans.story:
三十根辐条共用一个毂，是中间的空让轮子有用。泥做成器皿，器皿的用处是那个空。墙上开了门窗，房间是里面的空。有的东西给了形状；没有的东西给了用处。

这是给排满的日历的一章。每个小时都填满的一周，是一个没有空腔的器皿：实心、沉重，什么也装不了。空出来的小时不是懒，它们是会工作的那部分。这一章没有叫谁少做；它说做需要不做，像轮子需要毂。刻意把空腔留在日子里，日子能装的反而更多。
zh_hans.reminder: 空的那部分，才是有用的部分。
zh_hans.acting: 把明天清单上的一件事划掉，让那个小时空着。

lines: 五色令人目盲五音令人耳聾

en.plain: Feeds, sales, notifications: by evening your eyes and your attention are worn out.
en.story:
The five colours blind the eye; the five notes deafen the ear; the five flavours numb the tongue; racing and hunting madden the mind; rare goods make people do harm. So the sage looks to the belly and not the eye.

Laozi wrote this about markets and courts, and it reads as if written about a phone. Too much colour does not enrich the eye, it wears it out. The chapter's response is not to close the eyes but to change what is being fed: the belly, meaning the body's real needs, rather than the eye, meaning the appetite for more stimulus. The evening feeling of being scraped hollow is the eye's tiredness. Feed the belly instead: a meal, a walk, sleep. The colours will still be there tomorrow, and there will be more of you to see them.
en.reminder: Feed the belly, not the eye.
en.acting: Put the phone in another room for the last hour of the evening.

zh_hant.plain: 動態、特賣、通知：到了晚上，你的眼睛和注意力都磨損了。
zh_hant.story:
五色讓眼睛盲，五音讓耳朵聾，五味讓舌頭麻，奔馳打獵讓心發狂，稀有的東西讓人做出傷害的事。所以聖人顧肚子，不顧眼睛。

老子寫的是市集和宮廷，讀起來卻像在寫手機。太多顏色不會讓眼睛更豐富，只會磨損它。這一章的回應不是閉上眼睛，而是換一種餵法：餵肚子，也就是身體真正的需要，而不是餵眼睛，也就是對更多刺激的胃口。晚上那種被刮空的感覺，是眼睛的疲倦。去餵肚子：一頓飯，一段路，睡覺。顏色明天還在，而看它們的你會多一點。
zh_hant.reminder: 餵肚子，不餵眼睛。
zh_hant.acting: 晚上最後一個小時，把手機放到另一個房間。

zh_hans.plain: 动态、特卖、通知：到了晚上，你的眼睛和注意力都磨损了。
zh_hans.story:
五色让眼睛盲，五音让耳朵聋，五味让舌头麻，奔驰打猎让心发狂，稀有的东西让人做出伤害的事。所以圣人顾肚子，不顾眼睛。

老子写的是市集和宫廷，读起来却像在写手机。太多颜色不会让眼睛更丰富，只会磨损它。这一章的回应不是闭上眼睛，而是换一种喂法：喂肚子，也就是身体真正的需要，而不是喂眼睛，也就是对更多刺激的胃口。晚上那种被刮空的感觉，是眼睛的疲倦。去喂肚子：一顿饭，一段路，睡觉。颜色明天还在，而看它们的你会多一点。
zh_hans.reminder: 喂肚子，不喂眼睛。
zh_hans.acting: 晚上最后一个小时，把手机放到另一个房间。

lines: 寵為下得之若驚失之若驚
吾所以有大患者為吾有身
故貴以身為天下若可寄天下
愛以身為天下若可託天下
chapters.translation_en:
Favour and disgrace would seem equally to be feared; honour and great calamity, to be regarded as personal conditions (of the same kind).
What is meant by speaking thus of favour and disgrace? Disgrace is being in a low position (after the enjoyment of favour). The getting that (favour) leads to the apprehension (of losing it), and the losing it leads to the fear of (still greater calamity):--this is what is meant by saying that favour and disgrace would seem equally to be feared.
And what is meant by saying that honour and great calamity are to be (similarly) regarded as personal conditions? What makes me liable to great calamity is my having the body (which I call myself); if I had not the body, what great calamity could come to me?
Therefore he who would administer the kingdom, honouring it as he honours his own person, may be employed to govern it, and he who would administer it with the love which he bears to his own person may be entrusted with it.

en.plain: Praise and criticism at work both leave you shaken, and you are tired of being shaken.
en.story:
Favour and disgrace are both alarming, Laozi says, and the great trouble is having a self to be alarmed on behalf of. Favour is alarming because it can be lost; disgrace because it has come. Only someone who values the world as they value their own body can be trusted with the world.

The chapter's observation is that praise unsettles as much as blame, which anyone who has been praised in a meeting and then lain awake will recognise. Both land on the same tender spot, the self that keeps score. Laozi's suggestion is not to stop caring but to move the care somewhere sturdier: the body, the work, the people in the room. Those can be tended without being alarmed. The shaking eases when there is less standing on the spot where it lands.
en.reminder: Praise and blame land on the same spot; stand elsewhere.
en.acting: After the next review, good or bad, go for a walk before you reply to anything.

zh_hant.plain: 工作上的稱讚和批評都讓你晃，而你已經厭倦了晃。
zh_hant.story:
老子說，得寵和受辱都讓人驚，而大患在於有一個「自己」可以替它驚。得寵讓人驚，是因為可能失去；受辱讓人驚，是因為它來了。只有把天下看得像自己身體一樣重的人，才可以把天下託付給他。

這一章的觀察是：稱讚讓人不安的程度不輸責備，在會議上被誇了、晚上卻睡不著的人都認得這件事。兩者落在同一個柔軟的點上，那個記分的自己。老子的建議不是不在乎，而是把在乎移到更結實的地方：身體、工作、房間裡的人。這些可以照顧，不必驚。當落點上站的東西少了，晃就緩了。
zh_hant.reminder: 稱讚和責備落在同一個點；站到別的地方。
zh_hant.acting: 下一次考核之後，不管好壞，先去走一段路，再回任何話。

zh_hans.plain: 工作上的称赞和批评都让你晃，而你已经厌倦了晃。
zh_hans.story:
老子说，得宠和受辱都让人惊，而大患在于有一个「自己」可以替它惊。得宠让人惊，是因为可能失去；受辱让人惊，是因为它来了。只有把天下看得像自己身体一样重的人，才可以把天下托付给他。

这一章的观察是：称赞让人不安的程度不输责备，在会议上被夸了、晚上却睡不着的人都认得这件事。两者落在同一个柔软的点上，那个记分的自己。老子的建议不是不在乎，而是把在乎移到更结实的地方：身体、工作、房间里的人。这些可以照顾，不必惊。当落点上站的东西少了，晃就缓了。
zh_hans.reminder: 称赞和责备落在同一个点；站到别的地方。
zh_hans.acting: 下一次考核之后，不管好坏，先去走一段路，再回任何话。

lines: 此三者不可致詰故混而為一
繩繩不可名復歸於無物
是謂無狀之狀無物之象
迎之不見其首隨之不見其後
chapters.translation_en:
We look at it, and we do not see it, and we name it 'the
Equable.' We listen to it, and we do not hear it, and we name it 'the
Inaudible.' We try to grasp it, and do not get hold of it, and we name it 'the Subtle.' With these three qualities, it cannot be made the subject of description; and hence we blend them together and obtain The One.
Its upper part is not bright, and its lower part is not obscure.
Ceaseless in its action, it yet cannot be named, and then it again returns and becomes nothing. This is called the Form of the Formless, and the Semblance of the Invisible; this is called the Fleeting and
Indeterminable.
We meet it and do not see its Front; we follow it, and do not see its Back. When we can lay hold of the Tao of old to direct the things of the present day, and are able to know it as it was of old in the beginning, this is called (unwinding) the clue of Tao.

en.plain: The future you keep trying to picture, next year's money, next year's work, will not come into focus.
en.story:
Look and it cannot be seen; listen and it cannot be heard; grasp and it cannot be held. Laozi describes the Tao as a form without form, an image without substance, and says you cannot meet its face or follow its back. Hold to the way of old to manage the present.

This is a chapter about the limits of foresight. Next year cannot be brought into focus because it has no form yet, and squinting harder produces only tiredness. The last line is the useful one: hold to what is known to manage what is now. The rent is known. This month's income is known. The next right action is usually visible from where you stand, even when the year is not. Steer by the near thing.
en.reminder: Steer by the near thing; the far one has no shape yet.
en.acting: Write down the one decision that can actually be made this week, and make it.

zh_hant.plain: 你一直想看清的那個未來，明年的錢、明年的工作，怎麼都對不了焦。
zh_hant.story:
看它看不見，聽它聽不到，抓它抓不住。老子形容道是沒有形狀的形狀、沒有實體的影像，說你迎不到它的臉，也跟不到它的背。守住古老的道，來處理現在。

這是一章關於「預見的極限」。明年對不了焦，因為它還沒有形狀，再用力瞇眼只會累。最後一句才是有用的：守住知道的，來處理現在的。房租是知道的。這個月的收入是知道的。下一步該做的事，通常從你站的地方看得到，就算一整年看不到。照近的東西掌舵。
zh_hant.reminder: 照近的東西掌舵；遠的還沒有形狀。
zh_hant.acting: 寫下這星期真的做得了的那一個決定，然後做它。

zh_hans.plain: 你一直想看清的那个未来，明年的钱、明年的工作，怎么都对不了焦。
zh_hans.story:
看它看不见，听它听不到，抓它抓不住。老子形容道是没有形状的形状、没有实体的影像，说你迎不到它的脸，也跟不到它的背。守住古老的道，来处理现在。

这是一章关于「预见的极限」。明年对不了焦，因为它还没有形状，再用力瞇眼只会累。最后一句才是有用的：守住知道的，来处理现在的。房租是知道的。这个月的收入是知道的。下一步该做的事，通常从你站的地方看得到，就算一整年看不到。照近的东西掌舵。
zh_hans.reminder: 照近的东西掌舵；远的还没有形状。
zh_hans.acting: 写下这星期真的做得了的那一个决定，然后做它。

lines: 古之善為士者微妙玄通
夫唯不可識故強為之容
儼兮其若容渙兮若冰之將釋
敦兮其若樸曠兮其若谷
夫唯不盈故能蔽不新成
chapters.translation_en:
The skilful masters (of the Tao) in old times, with a subtle and exquisite penetration, comprehended its mysteries, and were deep (also) so as to elude men's knowledge. As they were thus beyond men's knowledge, I will make an effort to describe of what sort they appeared to be.
Shrinking looked they like those who wade through a stream in winter; irresolute like those who are afraid of all around them; grave like a guest (in awe of his host); evanescent like ice that is melting away; unpretentious like wood that has not been fashioned into anything; vacant like a valley, and dull like muddy water.
Who can (make) the muddy water (clear)? Let it be still, and it will gradually become clear. Who can secure the condition of rest?
Let movement go on, and the condition of rest will gradually arise.
They who preserve this method of the Tao do not wish to be full (of themselves). It is through their not being full of themselves that they can afford to seem worn and not appear new and complete.

en.plain: The water in your life is muddy right now: a decision pending, a relationship unclear, money unsettled.
en.story:
Laozi describes the old masters as careful like someone crossing a winter stream, alert like someone who fears the neighbours, yielding like ice about to melt, plain like uncut wood, open like a valley, murky like muddy water. Then the question: who can let muddy water settle and slowly grow clear? Who can stay still until the right movement comes?

Muddy water clears by being left alone. Stirring it, however well-meant, keeps the mud up. A decision that will not resolve, a relationship whose shape is unclear: the instinct is to stir, to have one more conversation, to decide something before bed. The chapter suggests the other method. Leave it. Do the nearest plain thing. The mud settles on its own timetable, and the clear water shows what the next movement is.
en.reminder: Muddy water clears by being left alone.
en.acting: Leave the unclear thing untouched for three days, and do one plain task instead.

zh_hant.plain: 你的生活現在是混的水：一個決定懸著，一段關係不清楚，錢不穩。
zh_hant.story:
老子形容古時候的修道者，小心得像冬天過河，警覺得像怕四鄰，柔得像快融的冰，樸得像沒雕的木，開闊得像山谷，混得像濁水。然後問：誰能讓濁水靜下來，慢慢變清？誰能安靜地等，等到對的動作來？

濁水是被放著才清的。攪它，就算是好意，也只會讓泥一直浮著。一個不肯定的決定，一段形狀不清的關係：本能是去攪，再談一次，今晚就決定什麼。這一章建議另一種方法。放著。做最近的那件平常的事。泥按自己的時間表沉下去，清了的水會顯出下一步該怎麼動。
zh_hant.reminder: 濁水是被放著才清的。
zh_hant.acting: 把那件不清楚的事三天不碰，改做一件平常的事。

zh_hans.plain: 你的生活现在是混的水：一个决定悬着，一段关系不清楚，钱不稳。
zh_hans.story:
老子形容古时候的修道者，小心得像冬天过河，警觉得像怕四邻，柔得像快融的冰，朴得像没雕的木，开阔得像山谷，混得像浊水。然后问：谁能让浊水静下来，慢慢变清？谁能安静地等，等到对的动作来？

浊水是被放着才清的。搅它，就算是好意，也只会让泥一直浮着。一个不肯定的决定，一段形状不清的关系：本能是去搅，再谈一次，今晚就决定什么。这一章建议另一种方法。放着。做最近的那件平常的事。泥按自己的时间表沉下去，清了的水会显出下一步该怎么动。
zh_hans.reminder: 浊水是被放着才清的。
zh_hans.acting: 把那件不清楚的事三天不碰，改做一件平常的事。

chapters.translation_en:
The (state of) vacancy should be brought to the utmost degree, and that of stillness guarded with unwearying vigour. All things alike go through their processes of activity, and (then) we see them return (to their original state). When things (in the vegetable world) have displayed their luxuriant growth, we see each of them return to its root. This returning to their root is what we call the state of stillness; and that stillness may be called a reporting that they have fulfilled their appointed end.
The report of that fulfilment is the regular, unchanging rule. To know that unchanging rule is to be intelligent; not to know it leads to wild movements and evil issues. The knowledge of that unchanging rule produces a (grand) capacity and forbearance, and that capacity and forbearance lead to a community (of feeling with all things).
From this community of feeling comes a kingliness of character; and he who is king-like goes on to be heaven-like. In that likeness to heaven he possesses the Tao. Possessed of the Tao, he endures long; and to the end of his bodily life, is exempt from all danger of decay.

en.plain: You lie down at night and the day keeps running: the unpaid invoice, the thing you said in the meeting, tomorrow's list.
en.story:
Empty out as far as it goes; hold still and keep holding. Then watch: everything busy returns, in time, to its root, the way leaves do. Returning to the root is stillness; stillness is returning to what one is. To know this constancy is to be clear; not to know it is to act blindly and come to harm.

The chapter is the sitting instruction of the book. At eleven at night the mind is a room with a television on in every corner, and the chapter is not an order to switch them all off, because that never works. It is a direction: toward empty, toward still, one breath out at a time, with no point at which it must be finished. The invoice will be there in the morning, unchanged, and can be handled then.
en.reminder: Toward empty, toward still, one breath at a time.
en.acting: Write tomorrow's first task on paper so the night does not have to hold it.

zh_hant.plain: 夜裡躺下，白天還在跑：沒付的請款單，會議上說的那句話，明天的清單。
zh_hant.story:
空，空到底；守住靜，一直守著。然後看：所有忙碌的事物，到時候都回到自己的根，像葉子那樣。回到根是靜；靜是回到自己本來的樣子。知道這個常，就是明；不知道，就會盲目地動，招來傷害。

這一章是整本書的靜坐指令。晚上十一點，腦子是一個每個角落都開著電視的房間，這一章不是要你把它們全部關掉的命令，因為那從來沒有用。它是一個方向：往空，往靜，一次吐一口氣，沒有哪一個點是非到不可的。請款單早上還會在，一樣的，那時再處理。
zh_hant.reminder: 往空，往靜，一次一口氣。
zh_hant.acting: 把明天第一件事寫在紙上，讓夜晚不必替你記著。

zh_hans.plain: 夜里躺下，白天还在跑：没付的请款单，会议上说的那句话，明天的清单。
zh_hans.story:
空，空到底；守住静，一直守着。然后看：所有忙碌的事物，到时候都回到自己的根，像叶子那样。回到根是静；静是回到自己本来的样子。知道这个常，就是明；不知道，就会盲目地动，招来伤害。

这一章是整本书的静坐指令。晚上十一点，脑子是一个每个角落都开着电视的房间，这一章不是要你把它们全部关掉的命令，因为那从来没有用。它是一个方向：往空，往静，一次吐一口气，没有哪一个点是非到不可的。请款单早上还会在，一样的，那时再处理。
zh_hans.reminder: 往空，往静，一次一口气。
zh_hans.acting: 把明天第一件事写在纸上，让夜晚不必替你记着。

chapters.translation_en:
In the highest antiquity, (the people) did not know that there were (their rulers). In the next age they loved them and praised them. In the next they feared them; in the next they despised them.
Thus it was that when faith (in the Tao) was deficient (in the rulers) a want of faith in them ensued (in the people).
How irresolute did those (earliest rulers) appear, showing (by their reticence) the importance which they set upon their words!
Their work was done and their undertakings were successful, while the people all said, 'We are as we are, of ourselves!'

en.plain: You manage a team, a class or a household, and it feels like nothing runs unless you push it.
en.story:
The best ruler, Laozi says, is one the people barely know exists. Next comes one they love and praise; then one they fear; then one they despise. When the best ruler's work is done and things go well, the people say: we did this ourselves.

The chapter is the opposite of most management advice, and it is right about tiredness. A household that only runs when pushed is exhausting for the one pushing, and it never learns to run. The best ruler's method is to set things up so that they carry themselves, then step back far enough that the credit goes to the people doing the carrying. It costs the pusher their sense of being essential. In return it gives them evenings.
en.reminder: Set it up, step back, let them say they did it.
en.acting: Hand one recurring task fully to someone else today, and do not check on it for a week.

zh_hant.plain: 你帶一個團隊、一個班、或一個家，覺得沒有你推，什麼都不會動。
zh_hant.story:
老子說，最好的君王，是人民幾乎不知道他存在的那一種。其次是被愛戴讚美的；再其次是被畏懼的；最差的是被輕視的。最好的君王把事情做成了，人民說：這是我們自己做到的。

這一章和多數管理建議相反，而它對「累」是對的。一個只有被推才會動的家，推的人累壞了，而家從來學不會自己動。最好的君王的方法，是把事情安排到它們能自己走，然後退到夠遠，讓功勞落在真正在走的人身上。代價是推的人失去「不可或缺」的感覺。換回來的是晚上。
zh_hant.reminder: 安排好，退後，讓他們說是自己做到的。
zh_hant.acting: 今天把一件固定的事完整交給別人，一星期不去看。

zh_hans.plain: 你带一个团队、一个班、或一个家，觉得没有你推，什么都不会动。
zh_hans.story:
老子说，最好的君王，是人民几乎不知道他存在的那一种。其次是被爱戴赞美的；再其次是被畏惧的；最差的是被轻视的。最好的君王把事情做成了，人民说：这是我们自己做到的。

这一章和多数管理建议相反，而它对「累」是对的。一个只有被推才会动的家，推的人累坏了，而家从来学不会自己动。最好的君王的方法，是把事情安排到它们能自己走，然后退到够远，让功劳落在真正在走的人身上。代价是推的人失去「不可或缺」的感觉。换回来的是晚上。
zh_hans.reminder: 安排好，退后，让他们说是自己做到的。
zh_hans.acting: 今天把一件固定的事完整交给别人，一星期不去看。

chapters.translation_en:
When the Great Tao (Way or Method) ceased to be observed, benevolence and righteousness came into vogue. (Then) appeared wisdom and shrewdness, and there ensued great hypocrisy.
When harmony no longer prevailed throughout the six kinships, filial sons found their manifestation; when the states and clans fell into disorder, loyal ministers appeared.

en.plain: The rules at work multiply every month, and the more rules there are, the less anyone trusts anyone.
en.story:
When the great way is abandoned, Laozi says, benevolence and righteousness appear. When cleverness appears, so does great hypocrisy. When the family is in discord, filial piety is praised. When the state is in chaos, loyal ministers are named.

The chapter reads the appearance of a virtue as the sign that its substance has gone. Nobody praises loyalty in a house where people are simply loyal. Every new rule at work is honest evidence of the trust it replaced. The point for one person is not to fix the organisation, which is beyond a single pair of hands. It is to notice which of your own rules are doing that job: a rule you made because the plain thing stopped happening. Sometimes the plain thing can be restored, and the rule can go.
en.reminder: A rule appears where trust left; sometimes trust can come back.
en.acting: Find one rule you set for yourself or others this year, and ask what it replaced.

zh_hant.plain: 公司的規矩每個月都在增加，規矩越多，越沒有人信任誰。
zh_hant.story:
老子說，大道被丟掉了，仁義才出現。聰明出現了，大偽也跟著來。家裡不和了，才會讚美孝順。國家亂了，才會表揚忠臣。

這一章把一種德的出現，讀成它的實質已經不在的信號。在一個人人本來就忠誠的家裡，沒有人讚美忠誠。公司裡每一條新規矩，都是它取代的那份信任的誠實證據。對一個人來說，重點不是修好整個組織，那不是一雙手做得到的。重點是看看自己的哪些規矩在做這件事：因為平常的事不再發生，才定下的規矩。有時候平常的事可以恢復，規矩就可以走了。
zh_hant.reminder: 信任離開的地方，規矩出現；有時候信任回得來。
zh_hant.acting: 找一條你今年給自己或別人定的規矩，問它取代了什麼。

zh_hans.plain: 公司的规矩每个月都在增加，规矩越多，越没有人信任谁。
zh_hans.story:
老子说，大道被丢掉了，仁义才出现。聪明出现了，大伪也跟着来。家里不和了，才会赞美孝顺。国家乱了，才会表扬忠臣。

这一章把一种德的出现，读成它的实质已经不在的信号。在一个人人本来就忠诚的家里，没有人赞美忠诚。公司里每一条新规矩，都是它取代的那份信任的诚实证据。对一个人来说，重点不是修好整个组织，那不是一双手做得到的。重点是看看自己的哪些规矩在做这件事：因为平常的事不再发生，才定下的规矩。有时候平常的事可以恢复，规矩就可以走了。
zh_hans.reminder: 信任离开的地方，规矩出现；有时候信任回得来。
zh_hans.acting: 找一条你今年给自己或别人定的规矩，问它取代了什么。

chapters.translation_en:
If we could renounce our sageness and discard our wisdom, it would be better for the people a hundredfold. If we could renounce our benevolence and discard our righteousness, the people would again become filial and kindly. If we could renounce our artful contrivances and discard our (scheming for) gain, there would be no thieves nor robbers.
 Those three methods (of government)
 Thought olden ways in elegance did fail
 And made these names their want of worth to veil;
 But simple views, and courses plain and true
 Would selfish ends and many lusts eschew.

en.plain: Every feed and every shop window is selling an upgrade, and the life without them looks shabby by comparison.
en.story:
Give up sageliness and cleverness, Laozi says, and people will be a hundred times better off; give up benevolence and righteousness, and they will return to natural affection; give up craft and profit, and there will be no thieves. Then, because those are only sayings, he adds what to hold instead: see the plain silk, embrace the uncut wood, have little self and few desires.

The comparison economy runs on the opposite instruction. The phone is a year old and the advert makes it feel like a failing. The chapter does not pretend the newer thing is worse. It only points at what is already in the room: the old phone that still calls your mother, the kitchen where dinner still gets made. Plain silk is still silk. Uncut wood is still wood, and it has all its options.
en.reminder: Plain silk is still silk.
en.acting: Pick one thing you were going to upgrade this month, and give it another year on purpose.

zh_hant.plain: 每一個動態、每一扇櫥窗都在賣升級，相比之下，沒有這些東西的生活看起來很寒酸。
zh_hant.story:
老子說，丟掉聖智，人民好上一百倍；丟掉仁義，人民回到自然的親情；丟掉巧利，就沒有盜賊。然後，因為這些只是說法，他加上該抱住的東西：見素抱樸，少私寡欲。

比較的經濟靠的是相反的指令。手機一歲了，廣告讓它像一種失敗。這一章沒有假裝新的東西比較差。它只是指著房間裡已經有的：那支還能打給媽媽的舊手機，那間晚餐還是在裡面煮出來的廚房。素絲還是絲。原木還是木，而且所有的可能都還在。
zh_hant.reminder: 素絲，還是絲。
zh_hant.acting: 挑一樣這個月本來要換掉的東西，刻意再讓它用一年。

zh_hans.plain: 每一个动态、每一扇橱窗都在卖升级，相比之下，没有这些东西的生活看起来很寒酸。
zh_hans.story:
老子说，丢掉圣智，人民好上一百倍；丢掉仁义，人民回到自然的亲情；丢掉巧利，就没有盗贼。然后，因为这些只是说法，他加上该抱住的东西：见素抱朴，少私寡欲。

比较的经济靠的是相反的指令。手机一岁了，广告让它像一种失败。这一章没有假装新的东西比较差。它只是指着房间里已经有的：那支还能打给妈妈的旧手机，那间晚餐还是在里面煮出来的厨房。素丝还是丝。原木还是木，而且所有的可能都还在。
zh_hans.reminder: 素丝，还是丝。
zh_hans.acting: 挑一样这个月本来要换掉的东西，刻意再让它用一年。

lines: 絕學無憂唯之與阿相去幾何
眾人熙熙如享太牢如春登臺
眾人皆有餘而我獨若遺
chapters.translation_en:
When we renounce learning we have no troubles.
 The (ready) 'yes,' and (flattering) 'yea;'--
 Small is the difference they display.
 But mark their issues, good and ill;--
 What space the gulf between shall fill?
What all men fear is indeed to be feared; but how wide and without end is the range of questions (asking to be discussed)!
The multitude of men look satisfied and pleased; as if enjoying a full banquet, as if mounted on a tower in spring. I alone seem listless and still, my desires having as yet given no indication of their presence. I am like an infant which has not yet smiled. I look dejected and forlorn, as if I had no home to go to. The multitude of men all have enough and to spare. I alone seem to have lost everything. My mind is that of a stupid man; I am in a state of chaos.
Ordinary men look bright and intelligent, while I alone seem to be benighted. They look full of discrimination, while I alone am dull and confused. I seem to be carried about as on the sea, drifting as if I had nowhere to rest. All men have their spheres of action, while
I alone seem dull and incapable, like a rude borderer. (Thus) I alone am different from other men, but I value the nursing-mother (the Tao).

en.plain: Everyone around you seems sure of what they want, and you feel like the only one adrift.
en.story:
This is the loneliest chapter in the book. Others are bright and busy, Laozi says, as if at a feast or climbing a tower in spring; I alone am quiet, like a baby who has not yet smiled. Others have more than enough; I alone seem to have lost something. Everyone else is clear and I am dim; everyone else is sharp and I am dull. I alone am different, and I value being fed by the mother.

What is startling is that Laozi does not resolve the loneliness. He describes it exactly, the feeling of being the one unsure person at the feast, and then simply keeps his own counsel. The last line is the only comfort offered, and it is enough: being fed by the source is worth more than being sure. The adrift feeling is not evidence of being lost. It is what it feels like to be still looking, while the others have stopped.
en.reminder: Unsure is what still looking feels like.
en.acting: Tell one trusted person that you do not know yet, and notice that the sky does not fall.

zh_hant.plain: 你身邊每個人好像都很確定自己要什麼，只有你像在漂。
zh_hant.story:
這是整本書最孤獨的一章。老子說，別人都明亮、忙碌，像在赴宴，像春天登台；只有我安靜，像還不會笑的嬰兒。別人都有餘，只有我好像掉了什麼。別人都清楚，我昏昏的；別人都精明，我糊糊的。只有我不一樣，而我看重被母親餵養。

驚人的是，老子沒有解決這份孤獨。他準確地描述它，宴席上唯一那個不確定的人的感覺，然後就只是守著自己的想法。最後一句是唯一給出的安慰，而它夠了：被源頭餵養，比確定更值錢。漂的感覺不是迷路的證據。那是還在找的人的感覺，而其他人已經停下來了。
zh_hant.reminder: 不確定，就是還在找的感覺。
zh_hant.acting: 跟一個信得過的人說「我還不知道」，然後注意，天沒有塌。

zh_hans.plain: 你身边每个人好像都很确定自己要什么，只有你像在漂。
zh_hans.story:
这是整本书最孤独的一章。老子说，别人都明亮、忙碌，像在赴宴，像春天登台；只有我安静，像还不会笑的婴儿。别人都有余，只有我好像掉了什么。别人都清楚，我昏昏的；别人都精明，我糊糊的。只有我不一样，而我看重被母亲喂养。

惊人的是，老子没有解决这份孤独。他准确地描述它，宴席上唯一那个不确定的人的感觉，然后就只是守着自己的想法。最后一句是唯一给出的安慰，而它够了：被源头喂养，比确定更值钱。漂的感觉不是迷路的证据。那是还在找的人的感觉，而其他人已经停下来了。
zh_hans.reminder: 不确定，就是还在找的感觉。
zh_hans.acting: 跟一个信得过的人说「我还不知道」，然后注意，天没有塌。

chapters.translation_en:
The grandest forms of active force
 From Tao come, their only source.
 Who can of Tao the nature tell?
 Our sight it flies, our touch as well.
 Eluding sight, eluding touch,
 The forms of things all in it crouch;
 Eluding touch, eluding sight,
 There are their semblances, all right.
 Profound it is, dark and obscure;
 Things' essences all there endure.
 Those essences the truth enfold
 Of what, when seen, shall then be told.
 Now it is so; 'twas so of old.
 Its name--what passes not away;
 So, in their beautiful array,
 Things form and never know decay.
How know I that it is so with all the beauties of existing things? By this (nature of the Tao).

en.plain: You are being asked to commit to a plan whose outcome nobody can actually see.
en.story:
The greatest power comes from following the way alone, Laozi says, and the way is elusive: within it there are images, within it there are things, within it there is a seed of truth. From ancient times its name has not departed, and by it the beginnings of all things can be seen.

The chapter is about trusting what cannot be fully seen. A plan for the next year, a course, a move: none can be seen through to the end from where you stand, and the demand to commit anyway feels like being asked to lie. Laozi's answer is that there is something real inside the dimness: images, things, a seed. Commit to the seed, which is visible, and not to the harvest, which is not. That is not a leap of faith. It is planting.
en.reminder: Commit to the seed, not to the harvest.
en.acting: Take the first concrete step of the plan today, and defer judging the rest until it grows.

zh_hant.plain: 有人要你對一個沒有人真的看得見結果的計畫做出承諾。
zh_hant.story:
老子說，最大的德是只跟著道走，而道是恍惚的：裡面有象，裡面有物，裡面有真實的精。從古到今，它的名字沒有離開過，靠它可以看見萬物的開端。

這一章講的是信任看不全的東西。明年的計畫、一門課、一次搬家：站在這裡沒有一樣看得到結尾，而「無論如何先承諾」的要求，像被要求說謊。老子的回答是，昏暗裡有真實的東西：象、物、精。對種子承諾，它看得見；不對收成承諾，它看不見。這不是信仰的一躍。這是播種。
zh_hant.reminder: 對種子承諾，不對收成承諾。
zh_hant.acting: 今天走出計畫具體的第一步，把對其餘部分的判斷留到它長出來。

zh_hans.plain: 有人要你对一个没有人真的看得见结果的计划做出承诺。
zh_hans.story:
老子说，最大的德是只跟着道走，而道是恍惚的：里面有象，里面有物，里面有真实的精。从古到今，它的名字没有离开过，靠它可以看见万物的开端。

这一章讲的是信任看不全的东西。明年的计划、一门课、一次搬家：站在这里没有一样看得到结尾，而「无论如何先承诺」的要求，像被要求说谎。老子的回答是，昏暗里有真实的东西：象、物、精。对种子承诺，它看得见；不对收成承诺，它看不见。这不是信仰的一跃。这是播种。
zh_hans.reminder: 对种子承诺，不对收成承诺。
zh_hans.acting: 今天走出计划具体的第一步，把对其余部分的判断留到它长出来。

lines: 是以聖人抱一為天下式
不自見故明不自是故彰
不自伐故有功不自矜故長
夫唯不爭故天下莫能與之爭
古之所謂曲則全者豈虛言哉
chapters.translation_en:
The partial becomes complete; the crooked, straight; the empty, full; the worn out, new. He whose (desires) are few gets them; he whose (desires) are many goes astray.
Therefore the sage holds in his embrace the one thing (of humility), and manifests it to all the world. He is free from self-display, and therefore he shines; from self-assertion, and therefore he is distinguished; from self-boasting, and therefore his merit is acknowledged; from self-complacency, and therefore he acquires superiority. It is because he is thus free from striving that therefore no one in the world is able to strive with him.
That saying of the ancients that 'the partial becomes complete' was not vainly spoken:--all real completion is comprehended under it.

en.plain: A plan for the year has bent out of shape: the job, the move, the savings, none of it went straight.
en.story:
What bends stays whole; what is crooked becomes straight; what is hollow becomes full; what is worn becomes new. Have little and gain; have much and be confused. So the sage holds to the one and is a model for the world: not showing off, and therefore seen; not asserting, and therefore known; not boasting, and therefore credited; not contending, and therefore uncontended.

A tree that bends in the wind keeps its roots. Most of the year does not go the way it was drawn in January, and it is easy to read that as failure. The bent shape is the shape of a thing that survived; the curve in the plan is where the plan met the world and gave a little. That is not a reason to stop steering. It is a reason to stop measuring the year against a straight line that never existed outside the drawing.
en.reminder: Bent is the shape of what survived.
en.acting: Redraw the plan with the bend in it, and give the next step a date.

zh_hant.plain: 一整年的計畫都變了形：工作、搬家、存款，沒有一件照直線走。
zh_hant.story:
能彎的保得住完整；彎曲的會變直；空的會滿；舊的會新。少就得到；多就迷惑。所以聖人抱住一，做天下的榜樣：不自我表現，所以被看見；不自以為是，所以被知道；不自誇，所以被記功；不爭，所以沒有人跟他爭。

風裡會彎的樹，根還在。一年多半不會照一月時畫的樣子走，很容易把這讀成失敗。彎掉的形狀是活下來的東西的形狀；計畫裡那道彎，是計畫碰到世界時讓了一點的地方。這不是不再掌舵的理由。它是一個理由，讓你不再拿一條圖紙以外從來不存在的直線來量這一年。
zh_hant.reminder: 彎，是活下來的東西的形狀。
zh_hant.acting: 把那道彎畫進計畫裡，給下一步一個日期。

zh_hans.plain: 一整年的计划都变了形：工作、搬家、存款，没有一件照直线走。
zh_hans.story:
能弯的保得住完整；弯曲的会变直；空的会满；旧的会新。少就得到；多就迷惑。所以圣人抱住一，做天下的榜样：不自我表现，所以被看见；不自以为是，所以被知道；不自夸，所以被记功；不争，所以没有人跟他争。

风里会弯的树，根还在。一年多半不会照一月时画的样子走，很容易把这读成失败。弯掉的形状是活下来的东西的形状；计划里那道弯，是计划碰到世界时让了一点的地方。这不是不再掌舵的理由。它是一个理由，让你不再拿一条图纸以外从来不存在的直线来量这一年。
zh_hans.reminder: 弯，是活下来的东西的形状。
zh_hans.acting: 把那道弯画进计划里，给下一步一个日期。

lines: 故飄風不終朝驟雨不終日
天地尚不能久而況於人乎
故從事於道者道者同於道
chapters.translation_en:
Abstaining from speech marks him who is obeying the spontaneity of his nature. A violent wind does not last for a whole morning; a sudden rain does not last for the whole day. To whom is it that these (two) things are owing? To Heaven and Earth. If Heaven and Earth cannot make such (spasmodic) actings last long, how much less can man!
Therefore when one is making the Tao his business, those who are also pursuing it, agree with him in it, and those who are making the manifestation of its course their object agree with him in that; while even those who are failing in both these things agree with him where they fail.
Hence, those with whom he agrees as to the Tao have the happiness of attaining to it; those with whom he agrees as to its manifestation have the happiness of attaining to it; and those with whom he agrees in their failure have also the happiness of attaining (to the Tao). (But) when there is not faith sufficient (on his part), a want of faith (in him) ensues (on the part of the others).

en.plain: The crisis has lasted so long that you have started to believe it is permanent.
en.story:
Nature does not talk much, Laozi says. A whirlwind does not last a morning; a downpour does not last a day. If heaven and earth cannot keep these up, how could a person? So follow the way and belong to it; lose it and belong to loss; either way, what you follow welcomes you.

The first half is meteorology and it is exact. Storms are, by their nature, things that stop. A crisis that has lasted eighteen months can feel like the climate, but the chapter insists it is weather: intense because it is temporary, temporary because it is intense. This is not a promise about when. It is a reminder about what kind of thing a storm is. Inside one, the useful work is small and dry: keep the roof on, feed the people, and do not build a permanent house around the storm.
en.reminder: A storm is, by nature, a thing that stops.
en.acting: Do the roof-and-food things today, and postpone any permanent decision until the weather changes.

zh_hant.plain: 危機拖太久了，你開始相信它是永久的。
zh_hant.story:
老子說，自然不多話。狂風吹不了一個早上，暴雨下不了一整天。天地都撐不住這些，人怎麼撐得住？所以跟著道走的，屬於道；跟著失走的，屬於失；你跟著什麼，什麼就接納你。

前一半是氣象學，而且準確。風暴按它的本性，就是會停的東西。一場拖了十八個月的危機，感覺像氣候，這一章堅持它是天氣：因為短暫所以猛烈，因為猛烈所以短暫。這不是關於「什麼時候」的承諾。這是提醒風暴是哪一種東西。在風暴裡，有用的工作又小又乾：把屋頂留住，把人餵飽，別繞著風暴蓋一棟永久的房子。
zh_hant.reminder: 風暴按它的本性，是會停的東西。
zh_hant.acting: 今天做屋頂和食物的事，永久的決定留到天氣變了再說。

zh_hans.plain: 危机拖太久了，你开始相信它是永久的。
zh_hans.story:
老子说，自然不多话。狂风吹不了一个早上，暴雨下不了一整天。天地都撑不住这些，人怎么撑得住？所以跟着道走的，属于道；跟着失走的，属于失；你跟着什么，什么就接纳你。

前一半是气象学，而且准确。风暴按它的本性，就是会停的东西。一场拖了十八个月的危机，感觉像气候，这一章坚持它是天气：因为短暂所以猛烈，因为猛烈所以短暂。这不是关于「什么时候」的承诺。这是提醒风暴是哪一种东西。在风暴里，有用的工作又小又干：把屋顶留住，把人喂饱，别绕着风暴盖一栋永久的房子。
zh_hans.reminder: 风暴按它的本性，是会停的东西。
zh_hans.acting: 今天做屋顶和食物的事，永久的决定留到天气变了再说。

lines: 自是者不彰自伐者無功
物或惡之故有道者不處
chapters.translation_en: He who stands on his tiptoes does not stand firm; he who stretches his legs does not walk (easily). (So), he who displays himself does not shine; he who asserts his own views is not distinguished; he who vaunts himself does not find his merit acknowledged; he who is self-conceited has no superiority allowed to him. Such conditions, viewed from the standpoint of the Tao, are like remnants of food, or a tumour on the body, which all dislike. Hence those who pursue (the course) of the Tao do not adopt and allow them.

en.plain: You have been standing on tiptoe for months, presenting a taller version of yourself, and your legs are shaking.
en.story:
Someone on tiptoe does not stand firm; someone taking huge strides does not walk far. Someone who shows off is not seen; someone who asserts is not noticed; someone who boasts is not credited; someone who brags does not last. To the way, Laozi says, these are leftover food and useless growths, and those who follow the way do not stay near them.

Standing on tiptoe is what a person does to seem taller in a room where height is rewarded, and it works for a while. The chapter's observation is about the legs. The posture cannot be held, and the strain shows before the height does. It is not a moral point; it is orthopaedics. The person standing flat on their feet in the same room is less tall and can stay all evening. Flat feet are also where the next step comes from.
en.reminder: Tiptoe cannot be held; flat feet can stay all evening.
en.acting: In the next meeting, say one thing at your actual height: a plain fact about what you have done.

zh_hant.plain: 你踮著腳好幾個月了，端出一個比較高的自己，腿在抖。
zh_hant.story:
踮著腳的人站不穩；跨大步的人走不遠。自我表現的人不被看見；自以為是的人不被注意；自誇的人不被記功；自大的人長久不了。老子說，對道來說，這些是剩飯和贅瘤，跟著道走的人不靠近它們。

踮腳，是一個人在獎賞身高的房間裡為了顯得高做的事，一陣子有用。這一章的觀察是關於腿的。那個姿勢撐不住，勉強比身高先露出來。這不是道德的重點，這是骨科。同一個房間裡腳平踩在地上的人，沒那麼高，可以待一整晚。平踩的腳，也是下一步的來處。
zh_hant.reminder: 踮腳撐不住；平踩的腳可以待一整晚。
zh_hant.acting: 下一次會議，用你真正的高度說一件事：一個關於你做過什麼的平實事實。

zh_hans.plain: 你踮着脚好几个月了，端出一个比较高的自己，腿在抖。
zh_hans.story:
踮着脚的人站不稳；跨大步的人走不远。自我表现的人不被看见；自以为是的人不被注意；自夸的人不被记功；自大的人长久不了。老子说，对道来说，这些是剩饭和赘瘤，跟着道走的人不靠近它们。

踮脚，是一个人在奖赏身高的房间里为了显得高做的事，一阵子有用。这一章的观察是关于腿的。那个姿势撑不住，勉强比身高先露出来。这不是道德的重点，这是骨科。同一个房间里脚平踩在地上的人，没那么高，可以待一整晚。平踩的脚，也是下一步的来处。
zh_hans.reminder: 踮脚撑不住；平踩的脚可以待一整晚。
zh_hans.acting: 下一次会议，用你真正的高度说一件事：一个关于你做过什么的平实事实。

lines: 周行而不殆可以為天下母
故道大天大地大王亦大
chapters.translation_en:
There was something undefined and complete, coming into existence before Heaven and Earth. How still it was and formless, standing alone, and undergoing no change, reaching everywhere and in no danger (of being exhausted)! It may be regarded as the Mother of all things.
I do not know its name, and I give it the designation of the Tao (the Way or Course). Making an effort (further) to give it a name I call it The Great.
Great, it passes on (in constant flow). Passing on, it becomes remote. Having become remote, it returns. Therefore the Tao is great; Heaven is great; Earth is great; and the (sage) king is also great. In the universe there are four that are great, and the (sage) king is one of them.
Man takes his law from the Earth; the Earth takes its law from
Heaven; Heaven takes its law from the Tao. The law of the Tao is its being what it is.

en.plain: You are at the bottom of a chain of demands, the boss, the landlord, the parents, and there seems to be no floor beneath you.
en.story:
Something formed before heaven and earth, silent and vast, standing alone and unchanging, moving everywhere without tiring: Laozi does not know its name and calls it the way. Then the chain: humans follow earth, earth follows heaven, heaven follows the way, and the way follows what is so of itself.

Everyone in the chapter's chain is following something, including heaven. The boss answers to a board, the board to a market, the landlord to a bank. That is not comfort exactly, but it corrects the picture of being uniquely at the bottom. And the chain ends somewhere solid: the way follows only what is so of itself. There is a floor. It is not the boss's approval or the bank's; it is the plain fact of what is so today, which nobody above you can revoke. Stand on that.
en.reminder: Everyone in the chain is following something; the floor is what is so.
en.acting: Write down two things that are so today, regardless of what anyone above you decides.

zh_hant.plain: 你在一條要求鏈的最底端，老闆、房東、父母，底下好像沒有地板。
zh_hant.story:
有一樣東西在天地之前就成形了，安靜而廣大，獨自站著不改變，到處運行不疲倦：老子不知道它的名字，叫它道。然後是那條鏈：人法地，地法天，天法道，道法自然。

這一章鏈上的每一個都在跟著什麼，包括天。老闆對董事會負責，董事會對市場，房東對銀行。這不算安慰，但它修正了「只有自己在最底」的畫面。而這條鏈結束在一個結實的地方：道只跟著自然而然的東西。有地板。不是老闆的認可或銀行的，是今天「就是如此」的平實事實，你上面的人沒有一個撤銷得了。站在那上面。
zh_hant.reminder: 鏈上的每一個都在跟著什麼；地板是「就是如此」。
zh_hant.acting: 寫下兩件今天就是如此的事，不管你上面的人決定什麼。

zh_hans.plain: 你在一条要求链的最底端，老板、房东、父母，底下好像没有地板。
zh_hans.story:
有一样东西在天地之前就成形了，安静而广大，独自站着不改变，到处运行不疲倦：老子不知道它的名字，叫它道。然后是那条链：人法地，地法天，天法道，道法自然。

这一章链上的每一个都在跟着什么，包括天。老板对董事会负责，董事会对市场，房东对银行。这不算安慰，但它修正了「只有自己在最底」的画面。而这条链结束在一个结实的地方：道只跟着自然而然的东西。有地板。不是老板的认可或银行的，是今天「就是如此」的平实事实，你上面的人没有一个撤销得了。站在那上面。
zh_hans.reminder: 链上的每一个都在跟着什么；地板是「就是如此」。
zh_hans.acting: 写下两件今天就是如此的事，不管你上面的人决定什么。

lines: 是以聖人終日行不離輜重
奈何萬乘之主而以身輕天下
chapters.translation_en:
Gravity is the root of lightness; stillness, the ruler of movement.
Therefore a wise prince, marching the whole day, does not go far from his baggage waggons. Although he may have brilliant prospects to look at, he quietly remains (in his proper place), indifferent to them. How should the lord of a myriad chariots carry himself lightly before the kingdom? If he do act lightly, he has lost his root (of gravity); if he proceed to active movement, he will lose his throne.

en.plain: The phone, the chat groups and the news have not left you a quiet minute in weeks.
en.story:
The heavy is the root of the light; the still is the master of the restless. So the sage travels all day without leaving the baggage wagons, and however splendid the sights, stays calm and detached. Why would the lord of ten thousand chariots treat himself lightly? Lightly, and the root is lost; restlessly, and the mastery is lost.

A phone is the opposite of a wagon: light, always bright, pulling constantly. The chapter does not ask anyone to give it up; bills, family and work are on it. It says which of the two is meant to be in charge. Restlessness is a good servant and a poor master. When stillness rules, the movement still happens, but in an order that someone chose. The evidence is in your hands: for the length of one line the phone is propped up and the pen is moving.
en.reminder: Stillness first; the movement can wait two minutes.
en.acting: Choose the one thing on the phone that needs doing, do it, then put the phone face down.

zh_hant.plain: 手機、群組、新聞，好幾個星期沒有留給你一分鐘安靜。
zh_hant.story:
重是輕的根；靜是躁的主人。所以聖人整天趕路，不離開載著補給的重車，再壯麗的風景也安然不動。萬乘之主，怎麼會拿自己輕率地對待？輕了，根就丟了；躁了，主人就丟了。

手機和重車正好相反：輕，一直亮，一直在拉。這一章沒有要誰放掉它；帳單、家人、工作都在上面。它只說兩者之中誰該當家。躁動是好僕人，壞主人。當安靜當家，動還是會發生，只是發生在某個人選好的順序裡。證據就在你手上：寫一句話的時間裡，手機立在一旁，筆在動。
zh_hant.reminder: 先安靜，動的事可以等兩分鐘。
zh_hant.acting: 挑出手機上真正要做的那一件，做完，然後把手機翻過來放。

zh_hans.plain: 手机、群、新闻，好几个星期没有留给你一分钟安静。
zh_hans.story:
重是轻的根；静是躁的主人。所以圣人整天赶路，不离开载着补给的重车，再壮丽的风景也安然不动。万乘之主，怎么会拿自己轻率地对待？轻了，根就丢了；躁了，主人就丢了。

手机和重车正好相反：轻，一直亮，一直在拉。这一章没有要谁放掉它；帐单、家人、工作都在上面。它只说两者之中谁该当家。躁动是好仆人，坏主人。当安静当家，动还是会发生，只是发生在某个人选好的顺序里。证据就在你手上：写一句话的时间里，手机立在一旁，笔在动。
zh_hans.reminder: 先安静，动的事可以等两分钟。
zh_hans.acting: 挑出手机上真正要做的那一件，做完，然后把手机翻过来放。

lines: 是以聖人常善救人故無棄人
常善救物故無棄物是謂襲明
不貴其師不愛其資雖智大迷
chapters.translation_en:
The skilful traveller leaves no traces of his wheels or footsteps; the skilful speaker says nothing that can be found fault with or blamed; the skilful reckoner uses no tallies; the skilful closer needs no bolts or bars, while to open what he has shut will be impossible; the skilful binder uses no strings or knots, while to unloose what he has bound will be impossible. In the same way the sage is always skilful at saving men, and so he does not cast away any man; he is always skilful at saving things, and so he does not cast away anything. This is called 'Hiding the light of his procedure.'
Therefore the man of skill is a master (to be looked up to) by him who has not the skill; and he who has not the skill is the helper of (the reputation of) him who has the skill. If the one did not honour his master, and the other did not rejoice in his helper, an (observer), though intelligent, might greatly err about them. This is called 'The utmost degree of mystery.'

en.plain: You made a mistake at work that everyone saw, and the replay in your head has no off switch.
en.story:
A good walker leaves no tracks; a good speaker makes no slips; a good counter needs no tally; a good door needs no bolt and cannot be opened; a good knot needs no rope and cannot be untied. So the sage is good at saving people and abandons no one, good at saving things and abandons nothing. The good person is the teacher of the not-yet-good; the not-yet-good are the material of the good.

The chapter's list of flawless skills is not a standard to fail against. Its point is in the second half: nobody is abandoned. The person who slipped in front of everyone is exactly the material the good is made from, and the slip is not a track that has to be scrubbed out. It is where the learning is. The replay will run for a while; that is what minds do. The off switch is the next competent thing, done quietly, in the same room.
en.reminder: The slip is the material, not the verdict.
en.acting: Do the next competent thing in front of the same people, and let it stand beside the mistake.

zh_hant.plain: 你在公司犯了一個大家都看見的錯，腦子裡的重播沒有關閉鍵。
zh_hant.story:
善走的不留痕跡；善說的沒有失言；善算的不用籌碼；善關門的不用門閂也開不了；善打結的不用繩子也解不開。所以聖人善於救人，不放棄任何人；善於救物，不放棄任何東西。善人是不善人的老師；不善人是善人的材料。

這一章那一串完美的本事，不是一個拿來衡量失敗的標準。重點在後半：沒有人被放棄。在眾人面前失手的那個人，正是「善」用來造成的材料，那次失手不是一道非擦掉不可的痕跡。那是學習所在的地方。重播會跑一陣子；腦子就是這樣。關閉鍵是下一件做得好的事，安安靜靜地，在同一個房間做。
zh_hant.reminder: 失手是材料，不是判決。
zh_hant.acting: 在同一群人面前做好下一件事，讓它站在那個錯的旁邊。

zh_hans.plain: 你在公司犯了一个大家都看见的错，脑子里的重播没有关闭键。
zh_hans.story:
善走的不留痕迹；善说的没有失言；善算的不用筹码；善关门的不用门闩也开不了；善打结的不用绳子也解不开。所以圣人善于救人，不放弃任何人；善于救物，不放弃任何东西。善人是不善人的老师；不善人是善人的材料。

这一章那一串完美的本事，不是一个拿来衡量失败的标准。重点在后半：没有人被放弃。在众人面前失手的那个人，正是「善」用来造成的材料，那次失手不是一道非擦掉不可的痕迹。那是学习所在的地方。重播会跑一阵子；脑子就是这样。关闭键是下一件做得好的事，安安静静地，在同一个房间做。
zh_hans.reminder: 失手是材料，不是判决。
zh_hans.acting: 在同一群人面前做好下一件事，让它站在那个错的旁边。

lines: 知其雄守其雌為天下谿
知其白守其黑為天下式
知其榮守其辱為天下谷
chapters.translation_en:
Who knows his manhood's strength,
 Yet still his female feebleness maintains;
 As to one channel flow the many drains,
 All come to him, yea, all beneath the sky.
 Thus he the constant excellence retains;
 The simple child again, free from all stains.
 Who knows how white attracts,
 Yet always keeps himself within black's shade,
 The pattern of humility displayed,
 Displayed in view of all beneath the sky;
 He in the unchanging excellence arrayed,
 Endless return to man's first state has made.
 Who knows how glory shines,
 Yet loves disgrace, nor e'er for it is pale;
 Behold his presence in a spacious vale,
 To which men come from all beneath the sky.
 The unchanging excellence completes its tale;
 The simple infant man in him we hail.
The unwrought material, when divided and distributed, forms vessels. The sage, when employed, becomes the Head of all the
Officers (of government); and in his greatest regulations he employs no violent measures.

en.plain: You have spent years learning to be tough at work, and you have forgotten how to be soft anywhere.
en.story:
Know the male and keep to the female, and be the valley of the world. Know the white and keep to the black, and be the model for the world. Know honour and keep to humility, and be the valley again. Then, Laozi says, you return to the infant, to the limitless, to the uncut wood; and when the uncut wood is carved it becomes useful, but the great carver does not cut.

Knowing the hard side is not the problem. Years of toughness at work are a real skill and they have paid for things. The chapter asks only that the other side be kept, the way a valley keeps its lowness while the mountains keep their height. Keeping to the soft does not mean losing the hard. It means being able to arrive home and not use it on the people there. The infant Laozi mentions is not helpless; it is a person before the carving, with the whole range still available.
en.reminder: Know the hard; keep to the soft.
en.acting: Leave the work voice at the door this evening and use the other one with one person at home.

zh_hant.plain: 你花了好幾年學會在工作上強硬，已經忘了怎麼在任何地方柔軟。
zh_hant.story:
知道雄，守住雌，做天下的溪谷。知道白，守住黑，做天下的榜樣。知道榮，守住辱，再做天下的山谷。老子說，這樣就回到嬰兒，回到無限，回到未雕的木；木被雕了才成器，而真正的大匠不雕。

知道硬的那一面不是問題。工作上多年的強硬是真本事，它付過很多帳。這一章只要求把另一面留著，像山谷留著它的低，山留著它的高。守住柔，不是失去硬。是能回到家，不把它用在家裡的人身上。老子說的嬰兒不是無助；那是一個雕刻之前的人，整個範圍都還在。
zh_hant.reminder: 知道硬的；守住軟的。
zh_hant.acting: 今晚把工作的聲音留在門口，對家裡的一個人用另一種聲音。

zh_hans.plain: 你花了好几年学会在工作上强硬，已经忘了怎么在任何地方柔软。
zh_hans.story:
知道雄，守住雌，做天下的溪谷。知道白，守住黑，做天下的榜样。知道荣，守住辱，再做天下的山谷。老子说，这样就回到婴儿，回到无限，回到未雕的木；木被雕了才成器，而真正的大匠不雕。

知道硬的那一面不是问题。工作上多年的强硬是真本事，它付过很多帐。这一章只要求把另一面留着，像山谷留着它的低，山留着它的高。守住柔，不是失去硬。是能回到家，不把它用在家里的人身上。老子说的婴儿不是无助；那是一个雕刻之前的人，整个范围都还在。
zh_hans.reminder: 知道硬的；守住软的。
zh_hans.acting: 今晚把工作的声音留在门口，对家里的一个人用另一种声音。

lines: 不可為也為者敗之執者失之
故物或行或隨或歔或吹
是以聖人去甚去奢去泰
chapters.translation_en:
If any one should wish to get the kingdom for himself, and to effect this by what he does, I see that he will not succeed. The kingdom is a spirit-like thing, and cannot be got by active doing. He who would so win it destroys it; he who would hold it in his grasp loses it.
 The course and nature of things is such that
 What was in front is now behind;
 What warmed anon we freezing find.
 Strength is of weakness oft the spoil;
 The store in ruins mocks our toil.
Hence the sage puts away excessive effort, extravagance, and easy indulgence.

en.plain: You have been trying to control every variable in the household, and the household is pushing back.
en.story:
Those who would take the world and shape it will not succeed, Laozi says. The world is a sacred vessel that cannot be shaped; whoever shapes it ruins it, whoever grasps it loses it. Some lead and some follow, some breathe softly and some hard, some are strong and some weak. So the sage avoids the extreme, the extravagant and the excessive.

A household is a small world, and the chapter's warning applies at that scale. Trying to set every variable, meals, screens, bedtimes, tone of voice, produces a house that pushes back, because the people in it are not variables. The chapter's list is the relief: some lead and some follow, some are strong and some weak, and that variety is the vessel's nature, not a flaw to be corrected. Keep the few rules that keep everyone safe. Let the rest breathe at its own rate.
en.reminder: The vessel cannot be shaped; it can be held.
en.acting: Drop one household rule this week that exists only to make things match your picture.

zh_hant.plain: 你一直想控制家裡的每一個變數，家在反推你。
zh_hant.story:
老子說，想拿起天下來塑造它的人，不會成功。天下是神聖的器皿，不能塑造；塑造它的人毀了它，抓住它的人失去它。有的領頭有的跟隨，有的呼吸輕有的重，有的強有的弱。所以聖人避開極端、奢侈和過度。

一個家是一個小的天下，這一章的警告在這個尺度上也成立。想設定每一個變數，吃飯、螢幕、睡覺時間、說話的語氣，會得到一個反推的家，因為裡面的人不是變數。這一章那份清單是鬆綁：有的領頭有的跟隨，有的強有的弱，這種多樣是器皿的本性，不是要修正的缺陷。留下那幾條讓大家安全的規矩。其餘的，讓它按自己的速度呼吸。
zh_hant.reminder: 器皿不能塑造；可以捧著。
zh_hant.acting: 這星期去掉一條只為了讓事情符合你想像的家規。

zh_hans.plain: 你一直想控制家里的每一个变量，家在反推你。
zh_hans.story:
老子说，想拿起天下来塑造它的人，不会成功。天下是神圣的器皿，不能塑造；塑造它的人毁了它，抓住它的人失去它。有的领头有的跟随，有的呼吸轻有的重，有的强有的弱。所以圣人避开极端、奢侈和过度。

一个家是一个小的天下，这一章的警告在这个尺度上也成立。想设置每一个变量，吃饭、屏幕、睡觉时间、说话的语气，会得到一个反推的家，因为里面的人不是变量。这一章那份清单是松绑：有的领头有的跟随，有的强有的弱，这种多样是器皿的本性，不是要修正的缺陷。留下那几条让大家安全的规矩。其余的，让它按自己的速度呼吸。
zh_hans.reminder: 器皿不能塑造；可以捧着。
zh_hans.acting: 这星期去掉一条只为了让事情符合你想像的家规。

lines: 以道佐人主者不以兵強天下
善有果而已不敢以取強
果而勿矜果而勿伐果而勿驕
物壯則老是謂不道不道早已
chapters.translation_en:
He who would assist a lord of men in harmony with the Tao will not assert his mastery in the kingdom by force of arms. Such a course is sure to meet with its proper return.
Wherever a host is stationed, briars and thorns spring up. In the sequence of great armies there are sure to be bad years.
A skilful (commander) strikes a decisive blow, and stops. He does not dare (by continuing his operations) to assert and complete his mastery. He will strike the blow, but will be on his guard against being vain or boastful or arrogant in consequence of it. He strikes it as a matter of necessity; he strikes it, but not from a wish for mastery.
When things have attained their strong maturity they become old.
This may be said to be not in accordance with the Tao: and what is not in accordance with it soon comes to an end.

en.plain: You won the argument, and the win has cost you the relationship it was about.
en.story:
Whoever helps a ruler by the way does not use weapons to force the world, Laozi says, for such things tend to come back. Where armies camp, thorns grow. A good leader achieves the result and stops; achieves it without pride, without boasting, without arrogance, achieves it because there is no choice, achieves it without forcing.

Arguments at home and at work are fought with words rather than weapons, and the chapter's point holds: force tends to come back. The argument that was won by pressing until the other person gave up leaves thorns in the room, and the thorns are still there when the next disagreement starts. The chapter's alternative is to stop at the result. Say the thing that needed saying, once. Achieve the necessary and leave the field, before the win becomes a conquest.
en.reminder: Achieve the result and stop; do not occupy the field.
en.acting: Go back to the person you won against and say the one thing that lets them keep their ground.

zh_hant.plain: 你贏了那場爭執，贏的代價是它原本是為了的那段關係。
zh_hant.story:
老子說，用道輔佐君王的人，不用武力強迫天下，因為那種事會回頭。軍隊駐紮的地方，長荊棘。好的領導者達到結果就停；達到而不驕，不誇，不傲，達到是因為不得不，達到而不強。

家裡和公司裡的爭執用的是話不是武器，這一章的重點仍然成立：強力會回頭。靠一直逼到對方放棄而贏的爭執，在房間裡留下荊棘，下一次分歧開始時荊棘還在。這一章的另一條路是在結果處停下。把需要說的話說一次。達成必要的，然後離開戰場，在贏變成征服之前。
zh_hant.reminder: 達到結果就停；不要佔領戰場。
zh_hant.acting: 回到你贏過的那個人那裡，說一句讓他站得住的話。

zh_hans.plain: 你赢了那场争执，赢的代价是它原本是为了的那段关系。
zh_hans.story:
老子说，用道辅佐君王的人，不用武力强迫天下，因为那种事会回头。军队驻扎的地方，长荆棘。好的领导者达到结果就停；达到而不骄，不夸，不傲，达到是因为不得不，达到而不强。

家里和公司里的争执用的是话不是武器，这一章的重点仍然成立：强力会回头。靠一直逼到对方放弃而赢的争执，在房间里留下荆棘，下一次分歧开始时荆棘还在。这一章的另一条路是在结果处停下。把需要说的话说一次。达成必要的，然后离开战场，在赢变成征服之前。
zh_hans.reminder: 达到结果就停；不要占领战场。
zh_hans.acting: 回到你赢过的那个人那里，说一句让他站得住的话。

lines: 夫佳兵者不祥之器物或惡之
君子居則貴左用兵則貴右
兵者不祥之器非君子之器
不得已而用之恬淡為上
勝而不美而美之者是樂殺人
則不可以得志於天下矣
偏將軍居左上將軍居右
殺人之眾以哀悲泣之戰勝
chapters.translation_en:
Now arms, however beautiful, are instruments of evil omen, hateful, it may be said, to all creatures. Therefore they who have the Tao do not like to employ them.
The superior man ordinarily considers the left hand the most honourable place, but in time of war the right hand. Those sharp weapons are instruments of evil omen, and not the instruments of the superior man;--he uses them only on the compulsion of necessity. Calm and repose are what he prizes; victory (by force of arms) is to him undesirable. To consider this desirable would be to delight in the slaughter of men; and he who delights in the slaughter of men cannot get his will in the kingdom.
On occasions of festivity to be on the left hand is the prized position; on occasions of mourning, the right hand. The second in command of the army has his place on the left; the general commanding in chief has his on the right;--his place, that is, is assigned to him as in the rites of mourning. He who has killed multitudes of men should weep for them with the bitterest grief; and the victor in battle has his place (rightly) according to those rites.

en.plain: Someone close to you is in a fight, a divorce, a lawsuit, a feud, and you are being asked to take a side.
en.story:
Weapons are instruments of ill omen, Laozi says, and the person of the way does not stay near them. In peace the left is honoured, in war the right; weapons are used only when there is no choice, and then with calm and without relish. A victory is not a thing to celebrate. Those who celebrate it delight in killing, and such people cannot have their way in the world. So a victory is treated like a funeral.

Being pulled into someone else's war is a specific kind of stress: the side has to be taken, and then the war is yours too. The chapter does not say to abandon the person. It says how to stand near a conflict without relish. Support the person; do not enjoy the fight. Refuse the celebration when their side wins a round, because the other side is someone's too. The calm is what keeps you useful to them after the war is over.
en.reminder: Stand by the person; take no pleasure in the fight.
en.acting: Tell the person you are with them, and decline the next invitation to enjoy the other side's loss.

zh_hant.plain: 你身邊的人正在打仗，離婚、官司、家族不和，而你被要求選邊。
zh_hant.story:
老子說，兵器是不祥的東西，有道的人不靠近。平時以左為尊，打仗以右為尊；兵器只在不得已時才用，用時也安靜而不快意。勝利不是值得慶祝的事。慶祝它的人，是以殺人為樂，這種人在天下得不了志。所以勝利要用喪禮的方式對待。

被拉進別人的戰爭是一種特定的壓力：邊要選，然後戰爭也變成你的。這一章沒有叫人拋下那個人。它說的是怎麼站在衝突旁邊而不快意。支持那個人；不要享受那場仗。他那一邊贏一回合時拒絕慶祝，因為另一邊也是某個人的。那份安靜，是仗打完之後你還能對他有用的原因。
zh_hant.reminder: 站在那個人身邊；不從那場仗裡取樂。
zh_hant.acting: 告訴那個人你跟他在一起，然後拒絕下一次「一起高興對方輸了」的邀請。

zh_hans.plain: 你身边的人正在打仗，离婚、官司、家族不和，而你被要求选边。
zh_hans.story:
老子说，兵器是不祥的东西，有道的人不靠近。平时以左为尊，打仗以右为尊；兵器只在不得已时才用，用时也安静而不快意。胜利不是值得庆祝的事。庆祝它的人，是以杀人为乐，这种人在天下得不了志。所以胜利要用丧礼的方式对待。

被拉进别人的战争是一种特定的压力：边要选，然后战争也变成你的。这一章没有叫人抛下那个人。它说的是怎么站在冲突旁边而不快意。支持那个人；不要享受那场仗。他那一边赢一回合时拒绝庆祝，因为另一边也是某个人的。那份安静，是仗打完之后你还能对他有用的原因。
zh_hans.reminder: 站在那个人身边；不从那场仗里取乐。
zh_hans.acting: 告诉那个人你跟他在一起，然后拒绝下一次「一起高兴对方输了」的邀请。

lines: 侯王若能守之萬物將自賓
夫亦將知止知止所以不殆
chapters.translation_en:
The Tao, considered as unchanging, has no name.
Though in its primordial simplicity it may be small, the whole world dares not deal with (one embodying) it as a minister. If a feudal prince or the king could guard and hold it, all would spontaneously submit themselves to him.
Heaven and Earth (under its guidance) unite together and send down the sweet dew, which, without the directions of men, reaches equally everywhere as of its own accord.
As soon as it proceeds to action, it has a name. When it once has that name, (men) can know to rest in it. When they know to rest in it, they can be free from all risk of failure and error.
The relation of the Tao to all the world is like that of the great rivers and seas to the streams from the valleys.

en.plain: You keep saying yes to one more responsibility, and nobody, including you, knows where your limit is.
en.story:
The way is nameless, like uncut wood, small and yet nothing can command it. When names begin, the cutting has begun, and once there are names, one should know where to stop. Knowing where to stop averts danger. The way is to the world what rivers are to the sea.

The chapter ends where the previous saying yes should have: knowing where to stop. Each new responsibility has a name, project lead, treasurer, the one who visits on Sundays, and each name is a cut in the wood. None is wrong. The chapter only observes that once the cutting has started, the person doing it needs a line beyond which they do not cut, or the wood is gone. Nobody else will draw the line for you; the requests will keep coming because they work. The limit is a thing you name first.
en.reminder: Once the cutting starts, know where to stop.
en.acting: Write down the one responsibility you will not take on this year, and say it aloud to one person.

zh_hant.plain: 你一直對「再多一件」說好，沒有人，包括你自己，知道你的界線在哪裡。
zh_hant.story:
道沒有名字，像未雕的木，小，卻沒有東西能支使它。名字一開始，雕刻就開始了；有了名字，就該知道在哪裡停。知道在哪裡停，就避開了危險。道對天下，像河流對海。

這一章的結尾，正是上一個「好」該停的地方：知道在哪裡停。每一份新責任都有名字，專案負責人、司庫、星期天去探望的那個人，每一個名字都是木頭上的一刀。沒有一刀是錯的。這一章只是觀察：雕刻一旦開始，雕的人需要一條不再往下雕的線，否則木頭就沒了。沒有別人會替你畫這條線；請求會一直來，因為它們有效。界線是你要先叫出名字的東西。
zh_hant.reminder: 雕刻一開始，就要知道在哪裡停。
zh_hant.acting: 寫下今年你不接的那一份責任，大聲對一個人說出來。

zh_hans.plain: 你一直对「再多一件」说好，没有人，包括你自己，知道你的界线在哪里。
zh_hans.story:
道没有名字，像未雕的木，小，却没有东西能支使它。名字一开始，雕刻就开始了；有了名字，就该知道在哪里停。知道在哪里停，就避开了危险。道对天下，像河流对海。

这一章的结尾，正是上一个「好」该停的地方：知道在哪里停。每一份新责任都有名字，项目负责人、司库、星期天去探望的那个人，每一个名字都是木头上的一刀。没有一刀是错的。这一章只是观察：雕刻一旦开始，雕的人需要一条不再往下雕的线，否则木头就没了。没有别人会替你画这条线；请求会一直来，因为它们有效。界线是你要先叫出名字的东西。
zh_hans.reminder: 雕刻一开始，就要知道在哪里停。
zh_hans.acting: 写下今年你不接的那一份责任，大声对一个人说出来。

chapters.translation_en:
He who knows other men is discerning; he who knows himself is intelligent. He who overcomes others is strong; he who overcomes himself is mighty. He who is satisfied with his lot is rich; he who goes on acting with energy has a (firm) will.
