He who does not fail in the requirements of his position, continues long; he who dies and yet does not perish, has longevity.

en.plain: You can read everyone in the office, and still cannot say what you yourself want from the next year.
en.story:
Knowing others is discernment; knowing yourself is clarity. Overcoming others is force; overcoming yourself is strength. Knowing what is enough is wealth. Acting with persistence is will. Not losing your place is endurance. Dying without perishing is long life.

The chapter is a ladder of six rungs, and the first two are the ones that matter most to a person who has become an expert on other people by necessity. That skill is real and tiring, because it points outward all day. The chapter turns the same attention inward for a moment, not to judge but to look: what is actually wanted from the next year, once everyone else's wants are set aside. The answer is often smaller and more specific than expected. A quieter job. One friend seen more. Sunday mornings kept free.
en.reminder: Reading yourself is the brighter light.
en.acting: Write one plain sentence about what you want from the next year, and keep it where you will see it.

zh_hant.plain: 辦公室裡每個人你都看得透，卻說不出自己想從明年得到什麼。
zh_hant.story:
看懂別人是聰明；看懂自己是清明。勝過別人是有力；勝過自己是強。知道什麼是足夠，是富。堅持去做，是有志。不失去自己的位置，是長久。死而不亡，是壽。

這一章是六級的梯子，前兩級對一個出於需要成了別人專家的人最要緊。那種本事是真的，也很累，因為它整天朝外。這一章把同一份注意力轉向裡面一會兒，不是為了評斷，只是看：把其他所有人的想要先擱到一邊之後，明年到底想要什麼。答案常常比想像的小、也具體。一份安靜一點的工作。多見一個朋友。把星期天早上留下來。
zh_hant.reminder: 看懂自己，是比較亮的那道光。
zh_hant.acting: 用一句平常的話寫下你想從明年得到什麼，放在看得到的地方。

zh_hans.plain: 办公室里每个人你都看得透，却说不出自己想从明年得到什么。
zh_hans.story:
看懂别人是聪明；看懂自己是清明。胜过别人是有力；胜过自己是强。知道什么是足够，是富。坚持去做，是有志。不失去自己的位置，是长久。死而不亡，是寿。

这一章是六级的梯子，前两级对一个出于需要成了别人专家的人最要紧。那种本事是真的，也很累，因为它整天朝外。这一章把同一份注意力转向里面一会儿，不是为了评断，只是看：把其他所有人的想要先搁到一边之后，明年到底想要什么。答案常常比想像的小、也具体。一份安静一点的工作。多见一个朋友。把星期天早上留下来。
zh_hans.reminder: 看懂自己，是比较亮的那道光。
zh_hans.acting: 用一句平常的话写下你想从明年得到什么，放在看得到的地方。

lines: 衣養萬物而不為主常無欲
萬物歸焉而不為主可名為大
以其終不自為大故能成其大
chapters.translation_en:
All-pervading is the Great Tao! It may be found on the left hand and on the right.
All things depend on it for their production, which it gives to them, not one refusing obedience to it. When its work is accomplished, it does not claim the name of having done it. It clothes all things as with a garment, and makes no assumption of being their lord;--it may be named in the smallest things. All things return (to their root and disappear), and do not know that it is it which presides over their doing so;--it may be named in the greatest things.
Hence the sage is able (in the same way) to accomplish his great achievements. It is through his not making himself great that he can accomplish them.

en.plain: You keep the household running, and nobody, including you, calls it an achievement.
en.story:
The great way flows everywhere, left and right. All things depend on it to live and it does not refuse them; it does its work and claims no name; it clothes and feeds all things and does not lord over them. Because it never claims to be great, it achieves greatness.

The chapter is a portrait of the person who keeps everything running and appears on no list of achievements. The meals, the forms, the appointments, the clothes that are clean on Monday: the way, Laozi says, works exactly like that, and it is the largest thing there is. This is not a consolation prize for invisible work. It is a claim about scale. The unnamed work is the kind everything else depends on, and the fact that it goes unnamed is part of how it is done well. Still, the person doing it may want it named once, and this chapter names it.
en.reminder: The unnamed work is the kind everything depends on.
en.acting: Name one piece of your unnamed work today, to yourself or to someone, in plain words.

zh_hant.plain: 你讓家運轉，沒有人，包括你自己，把這叫做成就。
zh_hant.story:
大道到處流，左邊右邊都是。萬物靠它活，它不拒絕；它做事而不佔名；它給萬物衣食而不主宰。因為它從不自稱偉大，所以成就了偉大。

這一章是一幅肖像：那個讓一切運轉、卻不出現在任何成就清單上的人。飯、表格、預約、星期一乾淨的衣服：老子說，道的運作就是這樣，而它是最大的東西。這不是給隱形工作的安慰獎。這是一個關於尺度的說法。沒有名字的工作，是其他一切所倚靠的那一種，而它沒有名字，正是它被做好的方式的一部分。不過，做它的人也許想聽它被叫出來一次，這一章把它叫出來了。
zh_hant.reminder: 沒有名字的工作，是一切所倚靠的那一種。
zh_hant.acting: 今天把你一件沒有名字的工作叫出來，對自己或對一個人，用平常的話。

zh_hans.plain: 你让家运转，没有人，包括你自己，把这叫做成就。
zh_hans.story:
大道到处流，左边右边都是。万物靠它活，它不拒绝；它做事而不占名；它给万物衣食而不主宰。因为它从不自称伟大，所以成就了伟大。

这一章是一幅肖像：那个让一切运转、却不出现在任何成就清单上的人。饭、表格、预约、星期一干净的衣服：老子说，道的运作就是这样，而它是最大的东西。这不是给隐形工作的安慰奖。这是一个关于尺度的说法。没有名字的工作，是其他一切所倚靠的那一种，而它没有名字，正是它被做好的方式的一部分。不过，做它的人也许想听它被叫出来一次，这一章把它叫出来了。
zh_hans.reminder: 没有名字的工作，是一切所倚靠的那一种。
zh_hans.acting: 今天把你一件没有名字的工作叫出来，对自己或对一个人，用平常的话。

lines: 視之不足見聽之不足聞
chapters.translation_en:
To him who holds in his hands the Great Image (of the invisible
Tao), the whole world repairs. Men resort to him, and receive no hurt, but (find) rest, peace, and the feeling of ease.
Music and dainties will make the passing guest stop (for a time).
But though the Tao as it comes from the mouth, seems insipid and has no flavour, though it seems not worth being looked at or listened to, the use of it is inexhaustible.

en.plain: The quiet, sensible option is on the table, and it has no pull at all compared with the loud one.
en.story:
Hold the great image and the world comes to you, comes and is not harmed, in peace and calm. Music and fine food make the passing traveller stop. But the way, when spoken, is flat and without flavour: looked at, it is not worth seeing; listened to, not worth hearing; used, it cannot be exhausted.

Laozi admits the problem openly: the way is boring next to music and food. The sensible option, the steady job, the early night, the modest plan, has no flavour and does not stop the traveller. The chapter's claim is only about the last clause: it cannot be used up. The loud option is loud because it spends something. The flat one is flat because it does not. Choosing it is not a failure of appetite. It is choosing the thing that will still be there next year.
en.reminder: Flat, and it cannot be used up.
en.acting: Choose the flavourless option once this week, and note how it feels a week later.

zh_hant.plain: 那個安靜、合理的選項在桌上，跟大聲的那個比起來，一點吸引力也沒有。
zh_hant.story:
抱住大象，天下就來，來了不受傷害，安平太。音樂和美食讓過路的人停下。但道說出來，淡而無味：看它，不值得看；聽它，不值得聽；用它，用不完。

老子公開承認這個問題：道在音樂和美食旁邊很無聊。合理的選項，穩定的工作、早睡、不大的計畫，沒有味道，留不住過路的人。這一章的說法只在最後一句：它用不完。大聲的選項大聲，是因為它花掉了什麼。平淡的選項平淡，是因為它沒有。選它不是胃口的失敗。是選那個明年還會在的東西。
zh_hant.reminder: 淡，而且用不完。
zh_hant.acting: 這星期選一次沒有味道的那個選項，一星期後注意它的感覺。

zh_hans.plain: 那个安静、合理的选项在桌上，跟大声的那个比起来，一点吸引力也没有。
zh_hans.story:
抱住大象，天下就来，来了不受伤害，安平太。音乐和美食让过路的人停下。但道说出来，淡而无味：看它，不值得看；听它，不值得听；用它，用不完。

老子公开承认这个问题：道在音乐和美食旁边很无聊。合理的选项，稳定的工作、早睡、不大的计划，没有味道，留不住过路的人。这一章的说法只在最后一句：它用不完。大声的选项大声，是因为它花掉了什么。平淡的选项平淡，是因为它没有。选它不是胃口的失败。是选那个明年还会在的东西。
zh_hans.reminder: 淡，而且用不完。
zh_hans.acting: 这星期选一次没有味道的那个选项，一星期后注意它的感觉。

chapters.translation_en:
When one is about to take an inspiration, he is sure to make a (previous) expiration; when he is going to weaken another, he will first strengthen him; when he is going to overthrow another, he will first have raised him up; when he is going to despoil another, he will first have made gifts to him:--this is called 'Hiding the light (of his procedure).'
The soft overcomes the hard; and the weak the strong.
Fishes should not be taken from the deep; instruments for the profit of a state should not be shown to the people.

en.plain: Someone at home or at work pushes hard, and you have been pushing back just as hard, and both of you are tired.
en.story:
What is to be shrunk must first be stretched; what is to be weakened must first be strengthened; what is to be brought down must first be raised. This is called subtle insight. The soft overcomes the hard; the weak overcomes the strong. Fish should not leave the deep water; a state's sharp instruments should not be shown to people.

Teeth are hard and fall out; the tongue is soft and stays. Softness is not giving in; it is the choice not to meet force with the same force. Picture the argument that keeps restarting, where every round the voices get harder and nothing moves. Say the thing once, quietly, and then stop pushing. The other person's pressure still exists and the disagreement is still real. What changes is that there is now something for the pressure to land on that does not crack.
en.reminder: Meet the hard thing with the soft one.
en.acting: Say it once, quietly, then stop pushing and let the silence work.

zh_hant.plain: 家裡或公司裡有一個人很用力地推你，你也一樣用力推回去，兩個人都累了。
zh_hant.story:
要收縮的，必先擴張；要削弱的，必先加強；要拉下的，必先抬高。這叫微明。柔弱勝過剛強。魚不該離開深水；國家的利器不該拿給人看。

牙齒硬，會掉；舌頭軟，留下來。柔軟不是認輸；它是選擇不用同樣的力氣去頂同樣的力氣。想一想那一場一直重來的爭執，每一回合聲音都更硬，什麼都沒有動。安靜地把話說一次，然後不再推。對方的壓力還在，分歧也還是真的。改變的是，現在有一樣東西讓那股壓力落下來，而且不會裂。
zh_hant.reminder: 用軟的，去接硬的。
zh_hant.acting: 安靜地把話說一次，然後停下來，讓沉默去做事。

zh_hans.plain: 家里或公司里有一个人很用力地推你，你也一样用力推回去，两个人都累了。
zh_hans.story:
要收缩的，必先扩张；要削弱的，必先加强；要拉下的，必先擡高。这叫微明。柔弱胜过刚强。鱼不该离开深水；国家的利器不该拿给人看。

牙齿硬，会掉；舌头软，留下来。柔软不是认输；它是选择不用同样的力气去顶同样的力气。想一想那一场一直重来的争执，每一回合声音都更硬，什么都没有动。安静地把话说一次，然后不再推。对方的压力还在，分歧也还是真的。改变的是，现在有一样东西让那股压力落下来，而且不会裂。
zh_hans.reminder: 用软的，去接硬的。
zh_hans.acting: 安静地把话说一次，然后停下来，让沉默去做事。

lines: 侯王若能守之萬物將自化
chapters.translation_en:
The Tao in its regular course does nothing (for the sake of doing it), and so there is nothing which it does not do.
If princes and kings were able to maintain it, all things would of themselves be transformed by them.
If this transformation became to me an object of desire, I would express the desire by the nameless simplicity.
 Simplicity without a name
 Is free from all external aim.
 With no desire, at rest and still,
 All things go right as of their will.
PART II.

en.plain: You are exhausted from managing outcomes: the children's grades, the team's numbers, the parents' health.
en.story:
The way never acts, yet nothing is left undone. If rulers could hold to it, all things would transform by themselves. And if, transforming, desire arose, it would be settled by the nameless uncut wood, and there would be stillness, and the world would right itself.

This is the chapter about not doing, and it is often misread as not caring. The person managing grades, numbers and a parent's health is not asked to stop caring. They are asked to notice how much of the managing is aimed at outcomes that were never theirs to produce. The child does the learning. The team does the work. The body does the healing. What remains for the manager is the conditions: food, time, calm, the appointment made. Set those and let the transformation happen at its own rate. Nothing is left undone; it is just not done by you.
en.reminder: Set the conditions; the outcome is not yours to produce.
en.acting: Pick one outcome you have been pushing, and today do only the condition for it, not the outcome.

zh_hant.plain: 你因為管理結果而累壞了：孩子的成績、團隊的數字、父母的健康。
zh_hant.story:
道從來不做，卻沒有一件事沒做成。君王若能守住它，萬物會自己轉化。轉化中若起了欲望，就用無名的樸來安定它，然後有靜，天下自己走正。

這是關於「無為」的一章，常被誤讀成不在乎。管理成績、數字和父母健康的人，不是被要求不在乎。是被要求注意，有多少管理是對準了本來就不由他們產生的結果。學習是孩子做的。工作是團隊做的。痊癒是身體做的。留給管理者的是條件：食物、時間、安靜、約好的門診。把這些設好，讓轉化按自己的速度發生。沒有一件事沒做成；只是不是你做的。
zh_hant.reminder: 設好條件；結果不由你產生。
zh_hant.acting: 挑一個你一直在推的結果，今天只做它的條件，不做結果。

zh_hans.plain: 你因为管理结果而累坏了：孩子的成绩、团队的数字、父母的健康。
zh_hans.story:
道从来不做，却没有一件事没做成。君王若能守住它，万物会自己转化。转化中若起了欲望，就用无名的朴来安定它，然后有静，天下自己走正。

这是关于「无为」的一章，常被误读成不在乎。管理成绩、数字和父母健康的人，不是被要求不在乎。是被要求注意，有多少管理是对准了本来就不由他们产生的结果。学习是孩子做的。工作是团队做的。痊愈是身体做的。留给管理者的是条件：食物、时间、安静、约好的门诊。把这些设好，让转化按自己的速度发生。没有一件事没做成；只是不是你做的。
zh_hans.reminder: 设好条件；结果不由你产生。
zh_hans.acting: 挑一个你一直在推的结果，今天只做它的条件，不做结果。

lines: 故失道而後德失德而後仁
失仁而後義失義而後禮
夫禮者忠信之薄而亂之首
前識者道之華而愚之始
是以大丈夫處其厚不居其薄
chapters.translation_en:
(Those who) possessed in highest degree the attributes (of the
Tao) did not (seek) to show them, and therefore they possessed them (in fullest measure). (Those who) possessed in a lower degree those attributes (sought how) not to lose them, and therefore they did not possess them (in fullest measure). (Those who) possessed in the highest degree those attributes did nothing (with a purpose), and had no need to do anything. (Those who) possessed them in a lower degree were (always) doing, and had need to be so doing. (Those who) possessed the highest benevolence were (always seeking) to carry it out, and had no need to be doing so. (Those who) possessed the highest righteousness were (always seeking) to carry it out, and had need to be so doing. (Those who) possessed the highest (sense of) propriety were (always seeking) to show it, and when men did not respond to it, they bared the arm and marched up to them.
Thus it was that when the Tao was lost, its attributes appeared; when its attributes were lost, benevolence appeared; when benevolence was lost, righteousness appeared; and when righteousness was lost, the proprieties appeared.
Now propriety is the attenuated form of leal-heartedness and good faith, and is also the commencement of disorder; swift apprehension is (only) a flower of the Tao, and is the beginning of stupidity.
Thus it is that the Great man abides by what is solid, and eschews what is flimsy; dwells with the fruit and not with the flower. It is thus that he puts away the one and makes choice of the other.

en.plain: You have been keeping up appearances, the right manners, the right words, and it has started to feel hollow.
en.story:
The highest virtue does not act virtuous, and so has virtue; the lowest never lets go of virtue, and so lacks it. Laozi then descends a staircase: when the way is lost there is virtue; when virtue is lost there is kindness; when kindness is lost there is duty; when duty is lost there is ritual. Ritual is the thin husk of loyalty and the beginning of disorder. So the sage stays with the substance and not the husk, with the fruit and not the flower.

The staircase is a diagnosis of hollowness. Manners are the last rung: what remains when the real thing has drained out. The chapter is not against manners. It is against mistaking the husk for the fruit, and it names the feeling of doing so. The cure is not better manners; it is one act of the real thing, however small, which the manners were originally there to express.
en.reminder: Stay with the fruit, not the flower.
en.acting: Do one substantive kindness today instead of the polite version of it.

zh_hant.plain: 你一直在維持表面，對的禮貌、對的話，開始覺得空。
zh_hant.story:
上德不自以為有德，所以有德；下德抓著德不放，所以沒有德。老子接著下一道樓梯：失了道才有德，失了德才有仁，失了仁才有義，失了義才有禮。禮是忠信的薄殼，是混亂的開始。所以聖人守著實質不守殼，守著果不守花。

這道樓梯是對「空」的診斷。禮貌是最後一級：真的東西流乾之後剩下的。這一章不反對禮貌。它反對把殼當成果，而它把這樣做的感覺叫了出來。解藥不是更好的禮貌；是一件真的事，再小也好，禮貌本來就是為了表達它才存在的。
zh_hant.reminder: 守著果，不守花。
zh_hant.acting: 今天做一件實在的善意，代替它有禮貌的版本。

zh_hans.plain: 你一直在维持表面，对的礼貌、对的话，开始觉得空。
zh_hans.story:
上德不自以为有德，所以有德；下德抓着德不放，所以没有德。老子接着下一道楼梯：失了道才有德，失了德才有仁，失了仁才有义，失了义才有礼。礼是忠信的薄壳，是混乱的开始。所以圣人守着实质不守壳，守着果不守花。

这道楼梯是对「空」的诊断。礼貌是最后一级：真的东西流干之后剩下的。这一章不反对礼貌。它反对把壳当成果，而它把这样做的感觉叫了出来。解药不是更好的礼貌；是一件真的事，再小也好，礼貌本来就是为了表达它才存在的。
zh_hans.reminder: 守着果，不守花。
zh_hans.acting: 今天做一件实在的善意，代替它有礼貌的版本。

lines: 天得一以清地得一以寧
神得一以靈谷得一以盈
故貴以賤為本高以下為基
是以侯王自稱孤寡不穀
故致數輿無輿不欲琭琭如玉

en.plain: Everything in your life is held up by one thing, one salary, one relationship, one health, and you feel the strain of it.
en.story:
Of old, these obtained the one: heaven and so became clear; earth and so became stable; spirits and so became potent; valleys and so became full; rulers and so became models. Without it, heaven would crack, earth would split, valleys would run dry, rulers would fall. So the noble is rooted in the humble, the high has the low for foundation.

The chapter is about what holds everything up, and its answer is unexpected: the low. Rulers, it says, call themselves orphan and widow, taking the humble names on purpose, because that is where the foundation is. For a life balanced on one salary, the practical reading is about the foundation under the salary: sleep, one friend, a body that works, a skill that would be worth something elsewhere. Those are the low things, and they are what holds the high thing up. Tend them and the strain eases, even before the salary changes.
en.reminder: The high thing rests on the low things; tend the low things.
en.acting: Do one thing today for the foundation, sleep, a friend, the body, rather than for the salary.

zh_hant.plain: 你生活裡的一切都靠一樣東西撐著，一份薪水、一段關係、一副身體，你感覺得到那份張力。
zh_hant.story:
從前得到「一」的：天因此清，地因此寧，神因此靈，谷因此盈，君王因此成為榜樣。沒有它，天會裂，地會崩，谷會乾，君王會倒。所以貴以賤為根，高以下為基。

這一章講的是什麼撐住一切，答案出乎意料：低的東西。它說，君王自稱孤、寡，故意取謙卑的名字，因為根基在那裡。對一個靠一份薪水平衡的人生，實際的讀法是薪水底下的根基：睡眠、一個朋友、一副能用的身體、一種在別處也值錢的本事。那些是低的東西，而它們正是撐住高的東西的。照顧它們，張力就會鬆，甚至在薪水改變之前。
zh_hant.reminder: 高的東西靠低的東西撐著；照顧低的東西。
zh_hant.acting: 今天為根基做一件事，睡眠、朋友、身體，而不是為薪水。

zh_hans.plain: 你生活里的一切都靠一样东西撑着，一份薪水、一段关系、一副身体，你感觉得到那份张力。
zh_hans.story:
从前得到「一」的：天因此清，地因此宁，神因此灵，谷因此盈，君王因此成为榜样。没有它，天会裂，地会崩，谷会干，君王会倒。所以贵以贱为根，高以下为基。

这一章讲的是什么撑住一切，答案出乎意料：低的东西。它说，君王自称孤、寡，故意取谦卑的名字，因为根基在那里。对一个靠一份薪水平衡的人生，实际的读法是薪水底下的根基：睡眠、一个朋友、一副能用的身体、一种在别处也值钱的本事。那些是低的东西，而它们正是撑住高的东西的。照顾它们，张力就会松，甚至在薪水改变之前。
zh_hans.reminder: 高的东西靠低的东西撑着；照顾低的东西。
zh_hans.acting: 今天为根基做一件事，睡眠、朋友、身体，而不是为薪水。

lines: 天下萬物生於有有生於無
chapters.translation_en:
The movement of the Tao
 By contraries proceeds;
 And weakness marks the course
 Of Tao's mighty deeds.
All things under heaven sprang from It as existing (and named); that existence sprang from It as non-existent (and not named).

en.plain: Things have been going backwards for a while, the savings, the career, the energy, and it is hard to read as anything but loss.
en.story:
Returning is the movement of the way; yielding is its use. All things arise from being; being arises from non-being. The chapter is four lines and the shortest in the book.

Going backwards is what returning looks like from the inside. The chapter does not promise that the savings come back or the career resumes where it left off. It says something about direction: that the way moves by returning, the way a tide does, and that what looks like retreat is one half of a motion whose other half is not yet visible. Yielding is not collapse; it is the use the way makes of a low point. The practical form is small: stop treating the backward stretch as a verdict, and do the yielding well, keeping what can be kept, until the motion turns.
en.reminder: Returning is how the way moves; the turn is not yet visible.
en.acting: Keep one thing intact through the backward stretch, and name it today.

zh_hant.plain: 事情已經倒退一陣子了，存款、事業、精力，很難把它讀成損失以外的東西。
zh_hant.story:
返回是道的運動；柔弱是道的用。萬物生於有，有生於無。這一章四句，是整本書最短的。

倒退，是「返回」從裡面看起來的樣子。這一章沒有承諾存款回來，或事業從停下的地方繼續。它說的是方向：道靠返回來運動，像潮汐那樣，而看起來像退卻的東西，是一個動作的一半，另一半還看不見。柔弱不是崩塌；它是道對一個低點的用法。實際的做法很小：不再把倒退的這一段當判決，把柔弱做好，留住留得住的，直到動作轉向。
zh_hant.reminder: 返回是道運動的方式；轉向還看不見。
zh_hant.acting: 在倒退的這一段留住一樣完整的東西，今天把它叫出來。

zh_hans.plain: 事情已经倒退一阵子了，存款、事业、精力，很难把它读成损失以外的东西。
zh_hans.story:
返回是道的运动；柔弱是道的用。万物生于有，有生于无。这一章四句，是整本书最短的。

倒退，是「返回」从里面看起来的样子。这一章没有承诺存款回来，或事业从停下的地方继续。它说的是方向：道靠返回来运动，像潮汐那样，而看起来像退却的东西，是一个动作的一半，另一半还看不见。柔弱不是崩塌；它是道对一个低点的用法。实际的做法很小：不再把倒退的这一段当判决，把柔弱做好，留住留得住的，直到动作转向。
zh_hans.reminder: 返回是道运动的方式；转向还看不见。
zh_hans.acting: 在倒退的这一段留住一样完整的东西，今天把它叫出来。

en.plain: You are older than the people around you who seem to have arrived, and the comparison stings.
en.story:
When the best students hear the way, they practise it; the middling keep and lose it; the worst laugh, and if they did not laugh it would not be the way. So the old sayings: the bright way seems dark, advancing seems retreating, the level seems rough, high virtue seems a valley, great purity seems soiled, the great square has no corners, the great vessel is completed late, the great note is faint, the great image has no form.

A potter shaping a small cup can finish it before lunch. A large vessel takes days, built up in stages and left to firm between them, or it collapses under its own weight. At thirty, forty, fifty it is easy to see people who seem finished. The line does not argue with the sting. It offers another reading of the same timeline: the thing still being built in you is large, and large things are slow because they have to be.
en.reminder: Large things are slow because they have to be.
en.acting: Name the one large thing still being built in you, and do today's small layer of it.

zh_hant.plain: 你比身邊那些看起來已經到位的人年紀大，這種比較會刺人。
zh_hant.story:
上士聽到道，就去實行；中士聽到，時有時無；下士聽到，大笑，不被笑就不足以為道。所以古話說：明亮的道好像暗，前進好像後退，平坦好像崎嶇，高的德好像山谷，大的潔白好像有污，大的方沒有角，大的器晚成，大的聲音幾乎聽不見，大的象沒有形。

陶匠做一個小杯子，午飯前就能做完。大的器物要好幾天，一層一層往上堆，每一層都得等它變硬，不然會被自己的重量壓垮。三十、四十、五十歲，很容易看見那些好像已經完成的人。這一句沒有跟刺痛爭。它給的是同一條時間線的另一種讀法：你身上還在建造的那樣東西是大的，大的東西慢，是因為它非慢不可。
zh_hant.reminder: 大的東西慢，因為它非慢不可。
zh_hant.acting: 說出你身上還在建造的那一件大東西，然後做今天那薄薄的一層。

zh_hans.plain: 你比身边那些看起来已经到位的人年纪大，这种比较会刺人。
zh_hans.story:
上士听到道，就去实行；中士听到，时有时无；下士听到，大笑，不被笑就不足以为道。所以古话说：明亮的道好像暗，前进好像后退，平坦好像崎岖，高的德好像山谷，大的洁白好像有污，大的方没有角，大的器晚成，大的声音几乎听不见，大的象没有形。

陶匠做一个小杯子，午饭前就能做完。大的器物要好几天，一层一层往上堆，每一层都得等它变硬，不然会被自己的重量压垮。三十、四十、五十岁，很容易看见那些好像已经完成的人。这一句没有跟刺痛争。它给的是同一条时间线的另一种读法：你身上还在建造的那样东西是大的，大的东西慢，是因为它非慢不可。
zh_hans.reminder: 大的东西慢，因为它非慢不可。
zh_hans.acting: 说出你身上还在建造的那一件大东西，然后做今天那薄薄的一层。

lines: 萬物負陰而抱陽沖氣以為和
故物或損之而益或益之而損
chapters.translation_en:
The Tao produced One; One produced Two; Two produced Three;
Three produced All things. All things leave behind them the Obscurity (out of which they have come), and go forward to embrace the
Brightness (into which they have emerged), while they are harmonised by the Breath of Vacancy.
What men dislike is to be orphans, to have little virtue, to be as carriages without naves; and yet these are the designations which kings and princes use for themselves. So it is that some things are increased by being diminished, and others are diminished by being increased.
What other men (thus) teach, I also teach. The violent and strong do not die their natural death. I will make this the basis of my teaching.

en.plain: You have been fighting for the top position, at work, in the family, and holding it is more tiring than reaching it was.
en.story:
The way gives birth to one, one to two, two to three, and three to all things. All things carry the dark and embrace the light, and the breath between them makes harmony. What people hate is to be orphaned, widowed, destitute, yet rulers take those as their titles. So a thing may be diminished and gain, or gain and be diminished. What others teach I teach too: the violent do not die a natural death. This I hold as the father of my teaching.

The chapter's middle is the useful part for someone holding the top. Rulers take the lowest names for themselves, and what is diminished may gain. Holding a position by force is what the last line warns about, in a form no one should test. The alternative is not to step down but to hold the position lightly, taking a low name, letting others gain, so that the holding stops being a fight. A position held that way is lighter, and it is also the one that lasts.
en.reminder: Hold the high place with a low name.
en.acting: Give away one piece of credit or control this week, on purpose, and notice what it costs and what it frees.

zh_hant.plain: 你一直在爭最上面的位子，工作上、家裡，守住它比爬上去更累。
zh_hant.story:
道生一，一生二，二生三，三生萬物。萬物背著陰抱著陽，中間的氣調和成和。人所厭惡的，是孤、寡、不穀，君王卻拿它們當稱號。所以一樣東西可能減損而得益，也可能得益而減損。別人教的我也教：強梁的人不得好死。我把這當作教的根本。

這一章的中段，對守著上位的人有用。君王給自己取最低的名字，減損的反而得益。靠強力守位子，正是最後一句警告的事，用一種誰都不該去試的形式。另一條路不是退下來，而是輕輕地守，取一個低的名字，讓別人得益，讓守位這件事不再是一場仗。這樣守的位子比較輕，也是留得久的那一種。
zh_hant.reminder: 用低的名字守高的位子。
zh_hant.acting: 這星期刻意讓出一份功勞或一份控制，注意它花了什麼，又鬆開了什麼。

zh_hans.plain: 你一直在争最上面的位子，工作上、家里，守住它比爬上去更累。
zh_hans.story:
道生一，一生二，二生三，三生万物。万物背着阴抱着阳，中间的气调和成和。人所厌恶的，是孤、寡、不谷，君王却拿它们当称号。所以一样东西可能减损而得益，也可能得益而减损。别人教的我也教：强梁的人不得好死。我把这当作教的根本。

这一章的中段，对守着上位的人有用。君王给自己取最低的名字，减损的反而得益。靠强力守位子，正是最后一句警告的事，用一种谁都不该去试的形式。另一条路不是退下来，而是轻轻地守，取一个低的名字，让别人得益，让守位这件事不再是一场仗。这样守的位子比较轻，也是留得久的那一种。
zh_hans.reminder: 用低的名字守高的位子。
zh_hans.acting: 这星期刻意让出一份功劳或一份控制，注意它花了什么，又松开了什么。

lines: 天下之至柔馳騁天下之至堅
chapters.translation_en:
The softest thing in the world dashes against and overcomes the hardest; that which has no (substantial) existence enters where there is no crevice. I know hereby what advantage belongs to doing nothing (with a purpose).
There are few in the world who attain to the teaching without words, and the advantage arising from non-action.

en.plain: You have been trying to force a change at work by pressure, and the pressure is bouncing off.
en.story:
The softest thing in the world overtakes the hardest. What has no substance enters where there is no gap. From this, Laozi says, I know the benefit of not forcing. Teaching without words and the benefit of not forcing: few in the world attain them.

Water gets into stone by not being stone. Pressure at work, the memo, the escalation, the raised voice, is the hard thing meeting the hard thing, and both stay where they were. The chapter proposes the soft route, which is slower and works: the question asked quietly, the example set without comment, the small change made without asking for permission it does not need. None of this is weakness. It is the method that gets into the gap the pressure could not find.
en.reminder: The soft thing enters where the hard thing bounces.
en.acting: Replace one push this week with one quiet example, and let it be noticed on its own.

zh_hant.plain: 你一直想用壓力在公司裡逼出一個改變，壓力被彈回來。
zh_hant.story:
天下最柔的東西，駕馭最堅硬的。沒有形體的，進入沒有縫隙的地方。老子說，我從這裡知道不強求的好處。不用話的教導，不強求的好處：天下很少有人做得到。

水進得了石頭，是因為它不是石頭。公司裡的壓力，那份備忘、那次上報、那個提高的聲音，是硬的東西碰上硬的東西，兩邊都留在原地。這一章提議柔的路，慢，但有效：安靜地問出的問題，不加評論做出的示範，不必問准就做的小改變。這些都不是軟弱。這是進得了壓力找不到的縫隙的方法。
zh_hant.reminder: 硬的東西彈回來的地方，軟的東西進得去。
zh_hant.acting: 這星期把一次推，換成一次安靜的示範，讓它自己被看見。

zh_hans.plain: 你一直想用压力在公司里逼出一个改变，压力被弹回来。
zh_hans.story:
天下最柔的东西，驾驭最坚硬的。没有形体的，进入没有缝隙的地方。老子说，我从这里知道不强求的好处。不用话的教导，不强求的好处：天下很少有人做得到。

水进得了石头，是因为它不是石头。公司里的压力，那份备忘、那次上报、那个提高的声音，是硬的东西碰上硬的东西，两边都留在原地。这一章提议柔的路，慢，但有效：安静地问出的问题，不加评论做出的示范，不必问准就做的小改变。这些都不是软弱。这是进得了压力找不到的缝隙的方法。
zh_hans.reminder: 硬的东西弹回来的地方，软的东西进得去。
zh_hans.acting: 这星期把一次推，换成一次安静的示范，让它自己被看见。

lines: 是故甚愛必大費多藏必厚亡
知足不辱知止不殆可以長久
chapters.translation_en:
Or fame or life,
 Which do you hold more dear?
 Or life or wealth,
 To which would you adhere?
 Keep life and lose those other things;
 Keep them and lose your life:--which brings
 Sorrow and pain more near?
 Thus we may see,
 Who cleaves to fame
 Rejects what is more great;
 Who loves large stores
 Gives up the richer state.
 Who is content
 Needs fear no shame.
 Who knows to stop
 Incurs no blame.
 From danger free
 Long live shall he.

en.plain: The rent takes half of what you earn, and the word 'enough' has nothing to do with your situation.
en.story:
Fame or the self: which is dearer? The self or wealth: which is worth more? Gain or loss: which is the greater harm? Excessive love costs greatly; hoarding loses much. Knowing what is enough averts disgrace; knowing where to stop averts danger; so one can last long.

Start from the rent. Half the salary goes to it, and a line about knowing what is enough can sound, from there, like advice from someone with a bigger flat. Laozi's chapter is actually addressed to the person who already has fame and stores. So read it narrowly. Knowing what is enough is not the same as having enough. It is a boundary drawn around what is being chased on top of the necessities: the second job that eats every evening, the upgrade on credit, the comparison that never closes. The rent is still too high. That is a fact about the city, and the chapter has nothing to say against the city.
en.reminder: Enough is a boundary, not a bank balance.
en.acting: Name one chase that is not a necessity, and take it off this month's list.

zh_hant.plain: 房租吃掉你收入的一半，「足夠」這個詞跟你的處境一點關係也沒有。
zh_hant.story:
名聲和自己，哪個親？自己和財貨，哪個重？得到和失去，哪個害處大？太過的愛，花費必大；囤積得多，損失必多。知道什麼是足夠，不受辱；知道在哪裡停，不危險；這樣才能長久。

從房租開始。薪水一半給它，從這裡讀一句關於知足的話，會像是一個住大房子的人給的建議。老子這一章其實是對已經有名聲、有積蓄的人說的。所以把它讀窄一點。知道什麼是足夠，不等於已經足夠。它是在必需品之外、那些被追著的東西周圍畫一條界線：吃掉每個晚上的第二份工，刷卡換的升級，永遠關不掉的比較。房租還是太高。那是關於這座城市的事實，這一章對這座城市沒有任何意見。
zh_hant.reminder: 足夠是一條界線，不是一個餘額。
zh_hant.acting: 說出一件不是必需的追逐，把它從這個月的清單上拿掉。

zh_hans.plain: 房租吃掉你收入的一半，「足够」这个词跟你的处境一点关系也没有。
zh_hans.story:
名声和自己，哪个亲？自己和财货，哪个重？得到和失去，哪个害处大？太过的爱，花费必大；囤积得多，损失必多。知道什么是足够，不受辱；知道在哪里停，不危险；这样才能长久。

从房租开始。薪水一半给它，从这里读一句关于知足的话，会像是一个住大房子的人给的建议。老子这一章其实是对已经有名声、有积蓄的人说的。所以把它读窄一点。知道什么是足够，不等于已经足够。它是在必需品之外、那些被追着的东西周围画一条界线：吃掉每个晚上的第二份工，刷卡换的升级，永远关不掉的比较。房租还是太高。那是关于这座城市的事实，这一章对这座城市没有任何意见。
zh_hans.reminder: 足够是一条界线，不是一个余额。
zh_hans.acting: 说出一件不是必需的追逐，把它从这个月的清单上拿掉。

chapters.translation_en:
Who thinks his great achievements poor
 Shall find his vigour long endure.
 Of greatest fulness, deemed a void,
 Exhaustion ne'er shall stem the tide.
 Do thou what's straight still crooked deem;
 Thy greatest art still stupid seem,
 And eloquence a stammering scream.
Constant action overcomes cold; being still overcomes heat. Purity and stillness give the correct law to all under heaven.

en.plain: At work you are slower and quieter than the people who talk well, and the promotion went to one of them.
en.story:
The greatest completion seems lacking, yet its use does not wear out. The greatest fullness seems empty, yet its use is not exhausted. The greatest straightness seems bent; the greatest skill seems clumsy; the greatest eloquence seems halting. Movement overcomes cold, stillness overcomes heat; clarity and stillness set the world right.

There is a kind of skill that shows and a kind that hides. The person who talks well in meetings has the first; the person who quietly makes the thing work, whose work nobody has to redo, has the second. In the short run the first is rewarded, and the promotion going the other way is a real loss of money and standing. The chapter does not pretend otherwise. It only says the clumsy-looking skill is the one that does not wear out, because it was never for show.
en.reminder: The skill that hides is the one that lasts.
en.acting: Write down one thing your quiet work made possible this month, and tell the person who decides.

zh_hant.plain: 在公司裡，你比那些會講話的人慢、也安靜，而升遷的是他們其中一個。
zh_hant.story:
最大的完成好像有缺，用起來卻不會壞。最大的充滿好像空，用起來卻不會盡。最直的好像彎；最巧的好像笨；最會說的好像口拙。動勝過冷，靜勝過熱；清靜讓天下走正。

本事有兩種，一種看得見，一種藏起來。開會講得好的人有第一種；安安靜靜把事情做到能用、沒有人需要重做的人有第二種。短期裡第一種比較被獎賞，升遷落到別人那邊是錢和地位的真實損失。這一章沒有假裝不是。它只說看起來笨拙的那種本事才不會壞，因為它從來就不是做給人看的。
zh_hant.reminder: 藏起來的本事，才留得久。
zh_hant.acting: 寫下這個月你安靜做成的一件事，然後告訴那個做決定的人。

zh_hans.plain: 在公司里，你比那些会讲话的人慢、也安静，而升迁的是他们其中一个。
zh_hans.story:
最大的完成好像有缺，用起来却不会坏。最大的充满好像空，用起来却不会尽。最直的好像弯；最巧的好像笨；最会说的好像口拙。动胜过冷，静胜过热；清静让天下走正。

本事有两种，一种看得见，一种藏起来。开会讲得好的人有第一种；安安静静把事情做到能用、没有人需要重做的人有第二种。短期里第一种比较被奖赏，升迁落到别人那边是钱和地位的真实损失。这一章没有假装不是。它只说看起来笨拙的那种本事才不会坏，因为它从来就不是做给人看的。
zh_hans.reminder: 藏起来的本事，才留得久。
zh_hans.acting: 写下这个月你安静做成的一件事，然后告诉那个做决定的人。

chapters.translation_en:
When the Tao prevails in the world, they send back their swift horses to (draw) the dung-carts. When the Tao is disregarded in the world, the war-horses breed in the border lands.
There is no guilt greater than to sanction ambition; no calamity greater than to be discontented with one's lot; no fault greater than the wish to be getting. Therefore the sufficiency of contentment is an enduring and unchanging sufficiency.

en.plain: The news is full of other people's wars and markets, and you cannot stop refreshing it.
en.story:
When the world has the way, horses are used to haul manure; when it lacks the way, warhorses are bred in the suburbs. No crime is greater than sanctioned desire; no misfortune greater than not knowing what is enough; no fault greater than wanting to get. So the contentment of knowing enough is lasting contentment.

The warhorses in the suburbs are the news feed. The refreshing is a small war conducted from a sofa, and it produces exactly what wars produce: alarm, no harvest. Laozi's contrast is the manure cart, the same horse doing the dull work that grows food. The chapter's practical turn is to move the attention from the wars you cannot affect to the field you can: the flat, the family, the work in front of you. The world's markets will move without your watching. The vegetables will not grow without your tending.
en.reminder: Manure cart, not warhorse.
en.acting: Set the news aside for one day, and do one hour of dull work that grows something.

zh_hant.plain: 新聞裡全是別人的戰爭和市場，你停不下來一直刷。
zh_hant.story:
天下有道，馬被拿去拉糞；天下無道，戰馬在城郊繁殖。沒有比縱容欲望更大的罪；沒有比不知足更大的禍；沒有比想要得到更大的過錯。所以知足的滿足，是長久的滿足。

城郊的戰馬就是新聞動態。一直刷，是從沙發上進行的一場小戰爭，而它產出的正是戰爭產出的東西：驚恐，沒有收成。老子的對照是糞車，同一匹馬做著長出糧食的無聊工作。這一章實際的轉向，是把注意力從你影響不了的戰爭，移到你影響得了的田：房子、家人、眼前的工作。世界的市場不需要你看也會動。菜不照顧就不會長。
zh_hant.reminder: 拉糞的馬，不是戰馬。
zh_hant.acting: 把新聞放一天，做一個小時會長出東西的無聊工作。

zh_hans.plain: 新闻里全是别人的战争和市场，你停不下来一直刷。
zh_hans.story:
天下有道，马被拿去拉粪；天下无道，战马在城郊繁殖。没有比纵容欲望更大的罪；没有比不知足更大的祸；没有比想要得到更大的过错。所以知足的满足，是长久的满足。

城郊的战马就是新闻动态。一直刷，是从沙发上进行的一场小战争，而它产出的正是战争产出的东西：惊恐，没有收成。老子的对照是粪车，同一匹马做着长出粮食的无聊工作。这一章实际的转向，是把注意力从你影响不了的战争，移到你影响得了的田：房子、家人、眼前的工作。世界的市场不需要你看也会动。菜不照顾就不会长。
zh_hans.reminder: 拉粪的马，不是战马。
zh_hans.acting: 把新闻放一天，做一个小时会长出东西的无聊工作。

lines: 是以聖人不行而知不見而名
chapters.translation_en:
Without going outside his door, one understands (all that takes place) under the sky; without looking out from his window, one sees the Tao of Heaven. The farther that one goes out (from himself), the less he knows.
Therefore the sages got their knowledge without travelling; gave their (right) names to things without seeing them; and accomplished their ends without any purpose of doing so.

en.plain: You feel you cannot understand your own situation until you have read one more article, taken one more course.
en.story:
Without going out of the door, one can know the world; without looking out of the window, one can see the way of heaven. The further one goes, the less one knows. So the sage knows without travelling, names without seeing, completes without doing.

The chapter is not against learning. It is against the belief that understanding is always one more source away. The person who cannot decide about their own finances until they have read another guide, or about their own marriage until they have done another course, has gone a long way out of the door and knows less for it. What is needed is usually already in the room: the bank statement, the conversation, a quiet hour. Sit with those before going out again.
en.reminder: The further you go for it, the less you know it.
en.acting: Cancel one more source today, and spend the hour looking at what you already have.

zh_hant.plain: 你覺得再讀一篇文章、再上一門課，才能理解自己的處境。
zh_hant.story:
不出門，就能知天下；不看窗外，就能見天道。走得越遠，知道得越少。所以聖人不遠行而知，不見而名，不做而成。

這一章不反對學習。它反對一種相信：理解永遠在下一個來源那裡。一個要再讀一本指南才敢決定自己的財務、要再上一門課才敢決定自己的婚姻的人，已經出門走了很遠，反而知道得更少。需要的東西通常已經在房間裡：銀行對帳單，那次談話，一個安靜的小時。先跟這些坐一坐，再出門。
zh_hant.reminder: 為了它走得越遠，越不知道它。
zh_hant.acting: 今天取消再多一個來源，把那個小時用來看你已經有的東西。

zh_hans.plain: 你觉得再读一篇文章、再上一门课，才能理解自己的处境。
zh_hans.story:
不出门，就能知天下；不看窗外，就能见天道。走得越远，知道得越少。所以圣人不远行而知，不见而名，不做而成。

这一章不反对学习。它反对一种相信：理解永远在下一个来源那里。一个要再读一本指南才敢决定自己的财务、要再上一门课才敢决定自己的婚姻的人，已经出门走了很远，反而知道得更少。需要的东西通常已经在房间里：银行对帐单，那次谈话，一个安静的小时。先跟这些坐一坐，再出门。
zh_hans.reminder: 为了它走得越远，越不知道它。
zh_hans.acting: 今天取消再多一个来源，把那个小时用来看你已经有的东西。

chapters.translation_en:
He who devotes himself to learning (seeks) from day to day to increase (his knowledge); he who devotes himself to the Tao (seeks) from day to day to diminish (his doing).
He diminishes it and again diminishes it, till he arrives at doing nothing (on purpose). Having arrived at this point of non-action, there is nothing which he does not do.
He who gets as his own all under heaven does so by giving himself no trouble (with that end). If one take trouble (with that end), he is not equal to getting as his own all under heaven.

en.plain: Your to-do list grows every day and the sense of being behind grows with it.
en.story:
In pursuit of learning, something is added every day. In pursuit of the way, something is dropped every day. Drop and drop again until there is no forcing, and then nothing is left undone. The world is won by not meddling; those who meddle are not fit to win it.

A list that only grows is the learning direction: something added every day. Laozi's other direction subtracts. Not by finishing more, which is the usual advice and which produces more, but by dropping: the task that was never yours, the standard nobody set but you, the meeting that could be an email nobody needs. Each thing dropped is a day's practice. The chapter's promise is oddly specific: after enough dropping, what remains gets done. The sense of being behind was measuring against the list, and the list was the problem.
en.reminder: Add every day, or drop every day; choose the second.
en.acting: Delete three items from the list today without doing them, and see which ones anyone notices.

zh_hant.plain: 你的待辦清單每天都在長，落後的感覺跟著長。
zh_hant.story:
求學，每天增加一點。求道，每天減少一點。減了再減，直到不再強求，然後沒有一件事沒做成。天下靠不干擾來取得；干擾的人，不配取得它。

只會長的清單，是求學的方向：每天加。老子的另一個方向是減。不是靠完成更多，那是常見的建議，而且只會生出更多；而是靠丟：從來就不是你的那件事，除了你沒有人定的那個標準，沒有人需要的那場會。每丟一樣，就是一天的修行。這一章的承諾奇怪地具體：丟得夠了，剩下的就會做完。落後的感覺是拿清單來量的，而清單就是問題。
zh_hant.reminder: 每天加，或每天減；選第二種。
zh_hant.acting: 今天從清單上刪掉三項，不做，看誰會注意到。

zh_hans.plain: 你的待办清单每天都在长，落后的感觉跟着长。
zh_hans.story:
求学，每天增加一点。求道，每天减少一点。减了再减，直到不再强求，然后没有一件事没做成。天下靠不干扰来取得；干扰的人，不配取得它。

只会长的清单，是求学的方向：每天加。老子的另一个方向是减。不是靠完成更多，那是常见的建议，而且只会生出更多；而是靠丢：从来就不是你的那件事，除了你没有人定的那个标准，没有人需要的那场会。每丢一样，就是一天的修行。这一章的承诺奇怪地具体：丢得够了，剩下的就会做完。落后的感觉是拿清单来量的，而清单就是问题。
zh_hans.reminder: 每天加，或每天减；选第二种。
zh_hans.acting: 今天从清单上删掉三项，不做，看谁会注意到。

lines: 聖人無常心以百姓心為心
chapters.translation_en:
The sage has no invariable mind of his own; he makes the mind of the people his mind.
To those who are good (to me), I am good; and to those who are not good (to me), I am also good;--and thus (all) get to be good. To those who are sincere (with me), I am sincere; and to those who are not sincere (with me), I am also sincere;--and thus (all) get to be sincere.
The sage has in the world an appearance of indecision, and keeps his mind in a state of indifference to all. The people all keep their eyes and ears directed to him, and he deals with them all as his children.

en.plain: Someone you have to deal with, a client, a relative, has not been fair to you, and you do not know how to keep treating them well.
en.story:
The sage has no fixed mind and takes the people's mind as his own. The good I treat well; the not-good I also treat well, and so goodness is achieved. The trustworthy I trust; the untrustworthy I also trust, and so trust is achieved. The sage lives in the world quietly and merges his mind with it; the people watch and listen, and the sage treats them all as children.

This chapter is often read as naive and it is nothing of the kind. It does not say the unfair person is fair. It says that your own conduct need not depend on theirs. Treating the difficult client with the same steadiness as the easy one is not a gift to the client; it is a refusal to let their unfairness set your terms. The steadiness is yours and stays yours. Boundaries still apply: treating someone well is not the same as letting them have what they want.
en.reminder: Their unfairness does not set your terms.
en.acting: Deal with the difficult person today exactly as you would with an easy one, and hold your boundary in the same breath.

zh_hant.plain: 你不得不應付的某個人，客戶、親戚，對你不公平，你不知道怎麼繼續好好對他。
zh_hant.story:
聖人沒有固定的心，把百姓的心當自己的心。善的人我善待；不善的人我也善待，這樣善才成就。守信的人我信任；不守信的人我也信任，這樣信才成就。聖人安靜地活在天下，把心融進去；百姓看著、聽著，聖人把他們都當孩子。

這一章常被讀成天真，它完全不是。它沒有說不公平的人是公平的。它說的是，你自己的行為不必取決於他們的。用對待好應付的客戶同樣的穩定去對待難應付的，不是送給客戶的禮物；是拒絕讓他們的不公平來定你的規則。那份穩定是你的，也留在你這裡。界線照樣適用：好好對待一個人，不等於讓他拿到他要的。
zh_hant.reminder: 他們的不公平，不定你的規則。
zh_hant.acting: 今天用對待好應付的人完全一樣的方式對待那個難的人，同一口氣裡守住你的界線。

zh_hans.plain: 你不得不应付的某个人，客户、亲戚，对你不公平，你不知道怎么继续好好对他。
zh_hans.story:
圣人没有固定的心，把百姓的心当自己的心。善的人我善待；不善的人我也善待，这样善才成就。守信的人我信任；不守信的人我也信任，这样信才成就。圣人安静地活在天下，把心融进去；百姓看着、听着，圣人把他们都当孩子。

这一章常被读成天真，它完全不是。它没有说不公平的人是公平的。它说的是，你自己的行为不必取决于他们的。用对待好应付的客户同样的稳定去对待难应付的，不是送给客户的礼物；是拒绝让他们的不公平来定你的规则。那份稳定是你的，也留在你这里。界线照样适用：好好对待一个人，不等于让他拿到他要的。
zh_hans.reminder: 他们的不公平，不定你的规则。
zh_hans.acting: 今天用对待好应付的人完全一样的方式对待那个难的人，同一口气里守住你的界线。

lines: 人之生動之死地亦十有三
蓋聞善攝生者陸行不遇兕虎
兕無所投其角虎無所措其爪
chapters.translation_en:
Men come forth and live; they enter (again) and die.
Of every ten three are ministers of life (to themselves); and three are ministers of death.
There are also three in every ten whose aim is to live, but whose movements tend to the land (or place) of death. And for what reason?
Because of their excessive endeavours to perpetuate life.
But I have heard that he who is skilful in managing the life entrusted to him for a time travels on the land without having to shun rhinoceros or tiger, and enters a host without having to avoid buff coat or sharp weapon. The rhinoceros finds no place in him into which to thrust its horn, nor the tiger a place in which to fix its claws, nor the weapon a place to admit its point. And for what reason?
Because there is in him no place of death.

en.plain: A health scare, yours or someone close, has made every ordinary day feel fragile.
en.story:
Coming out into life, going back into death: three in ten are companions of life, three in ten companions of death, and three in ten move toward death by their own clinging to life. Why? Because they live too intensely. Those who are good at keeping life walk without meeting tiger or rhinoceros and enter battle without armour; the tiger finds nowhere to put its claws, the weapon nowhere to enter, because in them there is no place for death.

The chapter is about the clinging that a scare produces, and it is careful. It does not say the scare is imaginary. It says that gripping life too intensely is itself one of the ways life is worn down: the sleepless checking, the bracing against every ordinary day. The person with no place for death is not fearless; they have simply stopped holding the day so tightly that it hurts. The ordinary day is not fragile. Holding it that way is.
en.reminder: Hold the day loosely; gripping is its own wearing.
en.acting: Do one ordinary thing today at its ordinary pace, without checking anything.

zh_hant.plain: 一場健康的驚嚇，你的或身邊人的，讓每一個平常的日子都變得脆弱。
zh_hant.story:
出來是生，回去是死：十分之三是生的同伴，十分之三是死的同伴，十分之三因為太執著於活，反而走向死。為什麼？因為活得太用力。善於保全生命的人，走路不遇虎和犀，上戰場不穿甲；虎找不到地方放爪子，兵器找不到地方進去，因為他們身上沒有死的位置。

這一章講的是驚嚇產生的執著，而且很小心。它沒有說驚嚇是假的。它說，把生命抓得太用力，本身就是生命被磨損的方式之一：失眠的檢查，對每一個平常日子的緊繃。身上沒有死的位置的人不是無畏；他們只是不再把日子抓得緊到會痛。平常的日子不脆弱。那樣抓著它，才脆弱。
zh_hant.reminder: 輕輕地拿著日子；抓緊本身就是磨損。
zh_hant.acting: 今天用平常的速度做一件平常的事，什麼都不檢查。

zh_hans.plain: 一场健康的惊吓，你的或身边人的，让每一个平常的日子都变得脆弱。
zh_hans.story:
出来是生，回去是死：十分之三是生的同伴，十分之三是死的同伴，十分之三因为太执著于活，反而走向死。为什么？因为活得太用力。善于保全生命的人，走路不遇虎和犀，上战场不穿甲；虎找不到地方放爪子，兵器找不到地方进去，因为他们身上没有死的位置。

这一章讲的是惊吓产生的执着，而且很小心。它没有说惊吓是假的。它说，把生命抓得太用力，本身就是生命被磨损的方式之一：失眠的检查，对每一个平常日子的紧绷。身上没有死的位置的人不是无畏；他们只是不再把日子抓得紧到会痛。平常的日子不脆弱。那样抓着它，才脆弱。
zh_hans.reminder: 轻轻地拿着日子；抓紧本身就是磨损。
zh_hans.acting: 今天用平常的速度做一件平常的事，什么都不检查。

lines: 道生之德畜之物形之勢成之
是以萬物莫不尊道而貴德
長之育之亭之毒之蓋之覆之
chapters.translation_en:
All things are produced by the Tao, and nourished by its outflowing operation. They receive their forms according to the nature of each, and are completed according to the circumstances of their condition. Therefore all things without exception honour the
Tao, and exalt its outflowing operation.
This honouring of the Tao and exalting of its operation is not the result of any ordination, but always a spontaneous tribute.
Thus it is that the Tao produces (all things), nourishes them, brings them to their full growth, nurses them, completes them, matures them, maintains them, and overspreads them.
It produces them and makes no claim to the possession of them; it carries them through their processes and does not vaunt its ability in doing so; it brings them to maturity and exercises no control over them;--this is called its mysterious operation.

en.plain: You did most of the work on something and someone else took the credit, and it is hard to keep doing the work.
en.story:
The way gives birth to things, virtue nurtures them, matter shapes them, circumstance completes them; so all things honour the way and value virtue, not by command but by nature. The way gives birth, nurtures, grows, matures, feeds, shelters. It produces without possessing, acts without presuming, leads without ruling. This is the deep virtue.

Four characters of it, 為而不恃, come down to a working rule: act, and do not lean on the act for reward. It is a hard rule on the week when the credit went elsewhere. The injustice is real and may need a real conversation; the chapter is about the next piece of work, and whether it can still be done well by someone who has stopped expecting recognition to pay them back. Oddly, work done that way is lighter. It does not have to carry the extra weight of being noticed.
en.reminder: Do the work; let it stand without leaning on it.
en.acting: Say plainly, once, what part of the work was yours, then get on with the next piece.

zh_hant.plain: 一件事大部分是你做的，功勞被別人拿走了，很難再繼續做下去。
zh_hant.story:
道生出萬物，德養育它們，物質給它們形狀，環境讓它們完成；所以萬物尊道貴德，不是誰命令的，是自然如此。道生它們、養它們、長它們、成它們、餵它們、護它們。生而不佔有，做而不倚仗，領導而不主宰。這是深的德。

其中四個字「為而不恃」，落到生活裡是一條工作的規矩：做，但不靠這件事來換回報。在功勞落到別人那裡的那一週，這條規矩很難。不公平是真的，也許需要一次真實的談話；這一章說的是下一件工作，以及一個不再期待被看見來償還他的人，還能不能把它做好。奇怪的是，這樣做的工作比較輕。它不必再多背一份被注意到的重量。
zh_hant.reminder: 把事做好，讓它自己站著，不去靠它。
zh_hant.acting: 把哪一部分是你做的，平實地說一次，然後繼續做下一件。

zh_hans.plain: 一件事大部分是你做的，功劳被别人拿走了，很难再继续做下去。
zh_hans.story:
道生出万物，德养育它们，物质给它们形状，环境让它们完成；所以万物尊道贵德，不是谁命令的，是自然如此。道生它们、养它们、长它们、成它们、喂它们、护它们。生而不占有，做而不倚仗，领导而不主宰。这是深的德。

其中四个字「为而不恃」，落到生活里是一条工作的规矩：做，但不靠这件事来换回报。在功劳落到别人那里的那一周，这条规矩很难。不公平是真的，也许需要一次真实的谈话；这一章说的是下一件工作，以及一个不再期待被看见来偿还他的人，还能不能把它做好。奇怪的是，这样做的工作比较轻。它不必再多背一份被注意到的重量。
zh_hans.reminder: 把事做好，让它自己站着，不去靠它。
zh_hans.acting: 把哪一部分是你做的，平实地说一次，然后继续做下一件。

lines: 既得其母以知其子既知其子
開其兌濟其事終身不救
chapters.translation_en:
(The Tao) which originated all under the sky is to be considered as the mother of them all.
When the mother is found, we know what her children should be.
When one knows that he is his mother's child, and proceeds to guard (the qualities of) the mother that belong to him, to the end of his life he will be free from all peril.
Let him keep his mouth closed, and shut up the portals (of his nostrils), and all his life he will be exempt from laborious exertion.
Let him keep his mouth open, and (spend his breath) in the promotion of his affairs, and all his life there will be no safety for him.
The perception of what is small is (the secret of) clear-sightedness; the guarding of what is soft and tender is (the secret of) strength.
 Who uses well his light,
 Reverting to its (source so) bright,
 Will from his body ward all blight,
 And hides the unchanging from men's sight.

en.plain: The days are a blur of small demands, and you have lost the thread of what any of it is for.
en.story:
The world has a beginning, which is its mother. Know the mother and you know the children; know the children and return to keep the mother, and to the end of life there is no danger. Block the openings, shut the doors, and life is not worn out; open them and multiply affairs, and life is beyond saving. Seeing the small is clarity; keeping to softness is strength. Use the light, return to the clarity, and leave no harm behind.

The children are the demands: the messages, the errands, the small fires. The mother is what they are all for, and the chapter's instruction is to keep returning to her. Not to abandon the children; they are real and they need feeding. But to shut the door for a while each day, so that the thread is found again. A person who knows what the demands are for can meet them without being worn out by them. A person who has lost the thread is worn out by each one.
en.reminder: Know the children; return to the mother.
en.acting: Write one sentence about what all of this week's small demands are for, and keep it visible.

zh_hant.plain: 日子是一團小要求的模糊，你已經找不到這一切是為了什麼的那條線。
zh_hant.story:
天下有一個開始，是它的母親。知道母親，就知道孩子；知道孩子，再回去守著母親，到老都沒有危險。堵住開口，關上門，生命不會耗盡；打開它們，事情越來越多，生命就救不回來。看得見小的，是明；守住柔的，是強。用它的光，回到它的明，不留下傷害。

孩子是那些要求：訊息、跑腿、小火災。母親是它們全部為了的東西，這一章的指令是一直回到她那裡。不是拋下孩子；他們是真的，需要被餵。而是每天關上門一會兒，好讓那條線再被找到。知道那些要求是為了什麼的人，可以應付它們而不被耗盡。失去那條線的人，被每一個都耗損。
zh_hant.reminder: 知道孩子；回到母親。
zh_hant.acting: 用一句話寫下這星期所有小要求是為了什麼，放在看得見的地方。

zh_hans.plain: 日子是一团小要求的模糊，你已经找不到这一切是为了什么的那条线。
zh_hans.story:
天下有一个开始，是它的母亲。知道母亲，就知道孩子；知道孩子，再回去守着母亲，到老都没有危险。堵住开口，关上门，生命不会耗尽；打开它们，事情越来越多，生命就救不回来。看得见小的，是明；守住柔的，是强。用它的光，回到它的明，不留下伤害。

孩子是那些要求：消息、跑腿、小火灾。母亲是它们全部为了的东西，这一章的指令是一直回到她那里。不是抛下孩子；他们是真的，需要被喂。而是每天关上门一会儿，好让那条线再被找到。知道那些要求是为了什么的人，可以应付它们而不被耗尽。失去那条线的人，被每一个都耗损。
zh_hans.reminder: 知道孩子；回到母亲。
zh_hans.acting: 用一句话写下这星期所有小要求是为了什么，放在看得见的地方。

lines: 使我介然有知行於大道
chapters.translation_en:
If I were suddenly to become known, and (put into a position to) conduct (a government) according to the Great Tao, what I should be most afraid of would be a boastful display.
The great Tao (or way) is very level and easy; but people love the by-ways.
Their court(-yards and buildings) shall be well kept, but their fields shall be ill-cultivated, and their granaries very empty. They shall wear elegant and ornamented robes, carry a sharp sword at their girdle, pamper themselves in eating and drinking, and have a superabundance of property and wealth;--such (princes) may be called robbers and boasters. This is contrary to the Tao surely!

en.plain: The shortcuts around you, the quick money, the corner cut, are getting more tempting as the honest road gets longer.
en.story:
If I had the least knowledge, Laozi says, I would walk the great way and fear only to stray. The great way is very level, yet people love the byways. The court is swept clean while the fields are full of weeds and the granaries empty; the officials wear fine clothes, carry sharp swords, gorge on food and drink, and have more wealth than they can use. This is called robbery in splendour; it is not the way.

The chapter names the temptation without softening it: the byways are loved because they are quick. Then it describes where they lead, in the form of people who have arrived by them, and it does not envy them. For someone whose honest road has grown long, this is not a lecture about virtue. It is an observation about the walk: the level road is level. It is boring, and it is the one that does not end in a locked door or a court. Stay on it, and let the byways stay tempting; they will.
en.reminder: The level road is boring and it is level.
en.acting: Take one honest step on the long road today, and let the shortcut go by without comment.

zh_hant.plain: 身邊的捷徑，快錢、偷的工，隨著誠實的路越來越長，越來越誘人。
zh_hant.story:
老子說，我若有一點點知識，就走大道，只怕走偏。大道很平，人卻愛走小路。朝廷掃得乾淨，田裡長滿雜草，糧倉空空；官員穿好衣、佩利劍，飽食豪飲，財富多到用不完。這叫做盜賊的炫耀；不是道。

這一章把誘惑叫出來，沒有軟化：小路被愛，是因為它快。然後它描述小路通到哪裡，用那些從小路走到的人的樣子，而它一點也不羨慕他們。對一個誠實的路已經走得很長的人，這不是關於美德的說教。這是關於走路的觀察：平的路是平的。它無聊，而它是那條不會在上鎖的門或法庭結束的路。留在上面，讓小路繼續誘人；它們會的。
zh_hant.reminder: 平的路無聊，而它是平的。
zh_hant.acting: 今天在長路上誠實地走一步，讓捷徑從旁邊過去，不評論。

zh_hans.plain: 身边的捷径，快钱、偷的工，随着诚实的路越来越长，越来越诱人。
zh_hans.story:
老子说，我若有一点点知识，就走大道，只怕走偏。大道很平，人却爱走小路。朝廷扫得干净，田里长满杂草，粮仓空空；官员穿好衣、佩利剑，饱食豪饮，财富多到用不完。这叫做盗贼的炫耀；不是道。

这一章把诱惑叫出来，没有软化：小路被爱，是因为它快。然后它描述小路通到哪里，用那些从小路走到的人的样子，而它一点也不羡慕他们。对一个诚实的路已经走得很长的人，这不是关于美德的说教。这是关于走路的观察：平的路是平的。它无聊，而它是那条不会在上锁的门或法庭结束的路。留在上面，让小路继续诱人；它们会的。
zh_hans.reminder: 平的路无聊，而它是平的。
zh_hans.acting: 今天在长路上诚实地走一步，让捷径从旁边过去，不评论。

chapters.translation_en:
What (Tao's) skilful planter plants
 Can never be uptorn;
 What his skilful arms enfold,
 From him can ne'er be borne.
 Sons shall bring in lengthening line,
 Sacrifices to his shrine.
 Tao when nursed within one's self,
 His vigour will make true;
 And where the family it rules
 What riches will accrue!
 The neighbourhood where it prevails
 In thriving will abound;
 And when 'tis seen throughout the state,
 Good fortune will be found.
 Employ it the kingdom o'er,
 And men thrive all around.
In this way the effect will be seen in the person, by the observation of different cases; in the family; in the neighbourhood; in the state; and in the kingdom.
How do I know that this effect is sure to hold thus all under the sky? By this (method of observation).

en.plain: You want to fix your whole family's problems at once, the finances, the feuds, the health, and it is not working.
en.story:
What is well planted is not uprooted; what is well held is not lost; and descendants keep the offering. Cultivate it in yourself and virtue is real; in the family and it overflows; in the village and it lasts; in the state and it abounds; in the world and it is universal. So look at the self by the self, the family by the family, the village by the village.

The chapter has an order, and the order is the point. Self, then family, then further out. Trying to fix the whole family's problems at once is starting at the wrong ring, and the family can feel it as pressure rather than help. The plant that is well rooted is the one that stays. Cultivate the one thing that is actually yours, your own finances, your own temper, your own health, and let the overflow reach the family on its own. It does, and it is not resisted the way pushing is.
en.reminder: Root it in yourself; let it overflow outward.
en.acting: Fix one thing that is entirely yours this week, and say nothing about anyone else's.

zh_hant.plain: 你想一次把全家的問題都修好，財務、不和、健康，做不到。
zh_hant.story:
種得好的不會被拔起；抱得好的不會丟失；子孫的祭祀才會延續。在自己身上修，德是真的；在家裡修，德有餘；在鄉里修，德長久；在國裡修，德豐富；在天下修，德普遍。所以用自己看自己，用家看家，用鄉看鄉。

這一章有一個順序，而順序就是重點。自己，然後家，然後更外面。想一次修好全家的問題，是從錯的那一圈開始，家會把它感覺成壓力而不是幫助。根扎得好的植物才留得住。修那件真正是你的事，你自己的財務、你自己的脾氣、你自己的健康，讓溢出來的部分自己到達家裡。它會的，而且不像推那樣被抵抗。
zh_hant.reminder: 在自己身上扎根；讓它往外溢。
zh_hant.acting: 這星期修好一件完全屬於你的事，對別人的事一句也不說。

zh_hans.plain: 你想一次把全家的问题都修好，财务、不和、健康，做不到。
zh_hans.story:
种得好的不会被拔起；抱得好的不会丢失；子孙的祭祀才会延续。在自己身上修，德是真的；在家里修，德有余；在乡里修，德长久；在国里修，德丰富；在天下修，德普遍。所以用自己看自己，用家看家，用乡看乡。

这一章有一个顺序，而顺序就是重点。自己，然后家，然后更外面。想一次修好全家的问题，是从错的那一圈开始，家会把它感觉成压力而不是帮助。根扎得好的植物才留得住。修那件真正是你的事，你自己的财务、你自己的脾气、你自己的健康，让溢出来的部分自己到达家里。它会的，而且不像推那样被抵抗。
zh_hans.reminder: 在自己身上扎根；让它往外溢。
zh_hans.acting: 这星期修好一件完全属于你的事，对别人的事一句也不说。

lines: 蜂蠆虺蛇不螫猛獸不據
物壯則老謂之不道不道早已
chapters.translation_en:
He who has in himself abundantly the attributes (of the Tao) is like an infant. Poisonous insects will not sting him; fierce beasts will not seize him; birds of prey will not strike him. (The infant's) bones are weak and its sinews soft, but yet its grasp is firm. It knows not yet the union of male and female, and yet its virile member may be excited;--showing the perfection of its physical essence. All day long it will cry without its throat becoming hoarse;--showing the harmony (in its constitution).
 To him by whom this harmony is known,
 (The secret of) the unchanging (Tao) is shown,
 And in the knowledge wisdom finds its throne.
 All life-increasing arts to evil turn;
 Where the mind makes the vital breath to burn,
 (False) is the strength, (and o'er it we should mourn.)
When things have become strong, they (then) become old, which may be said to be contrary to the Tao. Whatever is contrary to the Tao soon ends.

en.plain: You are tense from morning to night, jaw clenched, shoulders up, and cannot remember how to be loose.
en.story:
One full of virtue is like an infant: wasps and snakes do not sting it, beasts do not seize it, birds of prey do not strike it. Its bones are soft, its sinews weak, yet its grip is firm. It cries all day and does not grow hoarse, because its harmony is perfect. Knowing harmony is constancy; knowing constancy is clarity. Forcing the breath is called straining, and what is forced grows old early.

The infant's trick is that its grip is firm and everything else is soft. Tension from morning to night is the opposite: everything gripped, including the parts that do no gripping. The chapter's last line is a physiology lesson: forced breath is strain, and strain ages. The way back is not to relax everything, which cannot be done on command, but to notice which one thing actually needs the grip, and to let the shoulders, the jaw and the breath do what the infant's do.
en.reminder: Firm grip, soft everything else.
en.acting: Three times today, drop the shoulders and let one breath out slowly before the next task.

zh_hant.plain: 你從早到晚都緊繃，牙關咬著，肩膀聳著，想不起怎麼鬆。
zh_hant.story:
德厚的人像嬰兒：毒蟲不螫他，猛獸不抓他，猛禽不撲他。骨頭軟，筋弱，握力卻牢。整天哭而不啞，因為和諧到了極處。知道和諧是常；知道常是明。硬逼呼吸叫做強，強的東西早衰。

嬰兒的訣竅是握力牢，其餘全軟。從早到晚的緊繃正相反：什麼都抓著，包括那些不負責抓的部位。這一章最後一句是生理課：硬逼的呼吸是強，強會早衰。回去的路不是全部放鬆，那沒辦法用命令做到，而是注意到底哪一件事真的需要那份握力，然後讓肩膀、牙關和呼吸做嬰兒的那些在做的事。
zh_hant.reminder: 握力牢，其餘全軟。
zh_hant.acting: 今天三次，在下一件事之前鬆開肩膀，慢慢吐一口氣。

zh_hans.plain: 你从早到晚都紧绷，牙关咬着，肩膀耸着，想不起怎么松。
zh_hans.story:
德厚的人像婴儿：毒虫不螫他，猛兽不抓他，猛禽不扑他。骨头软，筋弱，握力却牢。整天哭而不哑，因为和谐到了极处。知道和谐是常；知道常是明。硬逼呼吸叫做强，强的东西早衰。

婴儿的诀窍是握力牢，其余全软。从早到晚的紧绷正相反：什么都抓着，包括那些不负责抓的部位。这一章最后一句是生理课：硬逼的呼吸是强，强会早衰。回去的路不是全部放松，那没办法用命令做到，而是注意到底哪一件事真的需要那份握力，然后让肩膀、牙关和呼吸做婴儿的那些在做的事。
zh_hans.reminder: 握力牢，其余全软。
zh_hans.acting: 今天三次，在下一件事之前松开肩膀，慢慢吐一口气。

lines: 故不可得而親不可得而疏
不可得而利不可得而害
不可得而貴不可得而賤
chapters.translation_en:
He who knows (the Tao) does not (care to) speak (about it); he who is (ever ready to) speak about it does not know it.
He (who knows it) will keep his mouth shut and close the portals (of his nostrils). He will blunt his sharp points and unravel the complications of things; he will attemper his brightness, and bring himself into agreement with the obscurity (of others). This is called
'the Mysterious Agreement.' (Such an one) cannot be treated familiarly or distantly; he is beyond all consideration of profit or injury; of nobility or meanness:--he is the noblest man under heaven.

en.plain: In a new job or a new city you feel either too much or invisible, and neither is comfortable.
en.story:
Those who know do not speak; those who speak do not know. Block the openings, shut the doors, blunt the sharpness, untangle the knots, soften the glare, join the dust: this is the deep union. It cannot be made close or distant, benefited or harmed, honoured or debased; so it is the world's most honoured.

Soften the light, join the dust: someone bright who chooses not to glare, and does not mind standing in the same dust as everyone else. Arriving somewhere new brings both opposite discomforts. Some days too visible, the new person whose every move is noticed; other days like dust, unseen in the corridor. The chapter accepts both and suggests a middle. Let the brightness be there, dimmed to a warmth that does not dazzle. Let the dust be there, and stand in it without shame, because everyone in the building is standing in it too.
en.reminder: Dim the light a little; stand in the same dust.
en.acting: Eat lunch with the others once this week and ask one question you have been guessing at.

zh_hant.plain: 到了新的公司或新的城市，你不是太顯眼就是像隱形的，兩種都不舒服。
zh_hant.story:
知道的人不說；說的人不知道。堵住開口，關上門，挫掉銳利，解開糾纏，柔和光芒，同於塵土：這叫玄同。它不能被親近或疏遠，不能被利或害，不能被貴或賤；所以是天下最尊貴的。

把光調柔，跟塵土在一起：一個明亮的人，選擇不刺眼，也不介意和所有人站在同一片塵土裡。到一個新地方，兩種相反的不舒服會一起來。有些日子太顯眼，新來的人，每個動作都被看著；另一些日子像灰塵，走廊上沒有人看見。這一章兩種都接受，然後提議一個中間。讓亮還在，調暗成一種不刺眼的暖。讓塵土也在，站在裡面不必羞愧，因為整棟樓的人都站在裡面。
zh_hant.reminder: 把光調暗一點，站進同一片塵土。
zh_hant.acting: 這星期跟大家吃一次午飯，把一直在猜的那件事問出口。

zh_hans.plain: 到了新的公司或新的城市，你不是太显眼就是像隐形的，两种都不舒服。
zh_hans.story:
知道的人不说；说的人不知道。堵住开口，关上门，挫掉锐利，解开纠缠，柔和光芒，同于尘土：这叫玄同。它不能被亲近或疏远，不能被利或害，不能被贵或贱；所以是天下最尊贵的。

把光调柔，跟尘土在一起：一个明亮的人，选择不刺眼，也不介意和所有人站在同一片尘土里。到一个新地方，两种相反的不舒服会一起来。有些日子太显眼，新来的人，每个动作都被看着；另一些日子像灰尘，走廊上没有人看见。这一章两种都接受，然后提议一个中间。让亮还在，调暗成一种不刺眼的暖。让尘土也在，站在里面不必羞愧，因为整栋楼的人都站在里面。
zh_hans.reminder: 把光调暗一点，站进同一片尘土。
zh_hans.acting: 这星期跟大家吃一次午饭，把一直在猜的那件事问出口。

lines: 故聖人云我無為而民自化
chapters.translation_en:
A state may be ruled by (measures of) correction; weapons of war may be used with crafty dexterity; (but) the kingdom is made one's own (only) by freedom from action and purpose.
How do I know that it is so? By these facts:--In the kingdom the multiplication of prohibitive enactments increases the poverty of the people; the more implements to add to their profit that the people have, the greater disorder is there in the state and clan; the more acts of crafty dexterity that men possess, the more do strange contrivances appear; the more display there is of legislation, the more thieves and robbers there are.
Therefore a sage has said, 'I will do nothing (of purpose), and the people will be transformed of themselves; I will be fond of keeping still, and the people will of themselves become correct. I will take no trouble about it, and the people will of themselves become rich; I will manifest no ambition, and the people will of themselves attain to the primitive simplicity.'

en.plain: Every fix you apply at home or at work seems to create two new problems.
en.story:
Govern a state by the ordinary, wage war by surprise, but win the world by not meddling. How do I know? The more prohibitions, the poorer the people; the sharper the tools, the more disorder; the cleverer the schemes, the stranger the outcomes; the more laws, the more thieves. So the sage says: I do nothing and the people transform; I love stillness and they right themselves; I do not meddle and they prosper; I want nothing and they return to simplicity.

The chapter is a description of fixes that breed problems, and anyone who has run a household or a team will recognise every line. The new rule creates the workaround. The clever scheme creates the strange outcome. Laozi's alternative is not passivity; it is restraint aimed at the one place restraint works: your own urge to intervene one more time. Let one thing right itself this week, and count how many problems it did not create.
en.reminder: The more fixes, the more to fix; try one fewer.
en.acting: Choose one problem at home or work and, this week, apply no fix to it at all.

zh_hant.plain: 你在家裡或公司每用一個辦法，好像都製造出兩個新問題。
zh_hant.story:
用正道治國，用奇計用兵，但用不干擾取天下。我怎麼知道？禁令越多，人民越窮；利器越多，越亂；巧計越多，怪事越多；法令越多，盜賊越多。所以聖人說：我不做，人民自己轉化；我愛靜，人民自己走正；我不干擾，人民自己富足；我沒有欲望，人民自己回到樸。

這一章描述會生問題的辦法，管過一個家或一個團隊的人，每一句都認得。新規矩生出繞路的方法。巧計生出怪事。老子的另一條路不是被動；是把克制對準克制唯一有效的地方：你自己再干預一次的衝動。這星期讓一件事自己走正，數數它沒有製造出幾個問題。
zh_hant.reminder: 辦法越多，要修的越多；試著少一個。
zh_hant.acting: 在家裡或公司挑一個問題，這星期完全不對它用任何辦法。

zh_hans.plain: 你在家里或公司每用一个办法，好像都制造出两个新问题。
zh_hans.story:
用正道治国，用奇计用兵，但用不干扰取天下。我怎么知道？禁令越多，人民越穷；利器越多，越乱；巧计越多，怪事越多；法令越多，盗贼越多。所以圣人说：我不做，人民自己转化；我爱静，人民自己走正；我不干扰，人民自己富足；我没有欲望，人民自己回到朴。

这一章描述会生问题的办法，管过一个家或一个团队的人，每一句都认得。新规矩生出绕路的方法。巧计生出怪事。老子的另一条路不是被动；是把克制对准克制唯一有效的地方：你自己再干预一次的冲动。这星期让一件事自己走正，数数它没有制造出几个问题。
zh_hans.reminder: 办法越多，要修的越多；试着少一个。
zh_hans.acting: 在家里或公司挑一个问题，这星期完全不对它用任何办法。

lines: 禍兮福之所倚福兮禍之所伏
chapters.translation_en:
The government that seems the most unwise,
 Oft goodness to the people best supplies;
 That which is meddling, touching everything,
 Will work but ill, and disappointment bring.
Misery!--happiness is to be found by its side! Happiness!--misery lurks beneath it! Who knows what either will come to in the end?
Shall we then dispense with correction? The (method of) correction shall by a turn become distortion, and the good in it shall by a turn become evil. The delusion of the people (on this point) has indeed subsisted for a long time.
Therefore the sage is (like) a square which cuts no one (with its angles); (like) a corner which injures no one (with its sharpness).
He is straightforward, but allows himself no license; he is bright, but does not dazzle.

en.plain: The bad news came all at once: a lost client, a broken appliance, a bill you did not expect.
en.story:
When the government is dull, the people are simple; when it is sharp, the people are cunning. Misfortune is what fortune leans on; fortune is where misfortune hides; who knows the end of it? There is no fixed right: right turns strange, good turns monstrous, and people have long been confused by this. So the sage is square without cutting, sharp without wounding, straight without straining, bright without dazzling.

A week when everything breaks at once does not feel like it is leaning on anything. The lost client is lost money; the washing machine is a real hole in the month. The chapter does not ask for gratitude. It asks for something smaller: to stop treating the bad week as the final shape of things. The client who left makes room for one who pays on time. Nobody knows yet, and not knowing is exactly what the chapter is about.
en.reminder: The bad week is not the final shape.
en.acting: Handle the two most urgent of the broken things today and leave the rest for tomorrow's list.

zh_hant.plain: 壞消息一次全來：丟了一個客戶，家電壞了，一張沒有預期的帳單。
zh_hant.story:
政府悶悶的，人民就淳樸；政府精明，人民就狡猾。禍是福倚靠的地方；福是禍藏身的地方；誰知道它的盡頭？沒有固定的正：正變成奇，善變成妖，人們對這件事迷惑很久了。所以聖人方正而不割人，銳利而不傷人，直而不勉強，亮而不刺眼。

所有東西同時壞掉的那一週，一點也不像靠著什麼。走掉的客戶就是少掉的錢；洗衣機壞了，這個月就真的破了一個洞。這一章沒有要求感恩。它要的比較小：不要再把這個壞的星期當成事情最後的形狀。離開的客戶讓出位子給一個準時付款的。沒有人現在就知道，而不知道正是這一章在說的事。
zh_hant.reminder: 壞的這一週，不是最後的形狀。
zh_hant.acting: 今天處理壞掉的事情裡最急的兩件，其餘留給明天的清單。

zh_hans.plain: 坏消息一次全来：丢了一个客户，家电坏了，一张没有预期的帐单。
zh_hans.story:
政府闷闷的，人民就淳朴；政府精明，人民就狡猾。祸是福倚靠的地方；福是祸藏身的地方；谁知道它的尽头？没有固定的正：正变成奇，善变成妖，人们对这件事迷惑很久了。所以圣人方正而不割人，锐利而不伤人，直而不勉强，亮而不刺眼。

所有东西同时坏掉的那一周，一点也不像靠着什么。走掉的客户就是少掉的钱；洗衣机坏了，这个月就真的破了一个洞。这一章没有要求感恩。它要的比较小：不要再把这个坏的星期当成事情最后的形状。离开的客户让出位子给一个准时付款的。没有人现在就知道，而不知道正是这一章在说的事。
zh_hans.reminder: 坏的这一周，不是最后的形状。
zh_hans.acting: 今天处理坏掉的事情里最急的两件，其余留给明天的清单。

lines: 是謂深根固柢長生久視之道
chapters.translation_en:
For regulating the human (in our constitution) and rendering the (proper) service to the heavenly, there is nothing like moderation.
It is only by this moderation that there is effected an early return (to man's normal state). That early return is what I call the repeated accumulation of the attributes (of the Tao). With that repeated accumulation of those attributes, there comes the subjugation (of every obstacle to such return). Of this subjugation we know not what shall be the limit; and when one knows not what the limit shall be, he may be the ruler of a state.
He who possesses the mother of the state may continue long. His case is like that (of the plant) of which we say that its roots are deep and its flower stalks firm:--this is the way to secure that its enduring life shall long be seen.

en.plain: You are spending yourself faster than you recover, and the deficit is starting to show.
en.story:
In governing people and serving heaven, nothing is like frugality. Frugality means early preparation; early preparation means storing up virtue; stored virtue means nothing cannot be overcome; then there is no known limit, and one can hold the state; with the mother of the state, one lasts long. This is called deep roots and a firm stem, the way of long life and lasting sight.

The frugality here is not about money, or not only. It is about spending yourself: attention, temper, hours of sleep. A person running a deficit of those is doing what the chapter warns against, spending before storing. The remedy is dull and effective: store early. The sleep before the hard week, not after. The quiet evening before the busy one. Deep roots are grown in the seasons when nothing seems to be happening, and they are what holds the stem when the wind comes.
en.reminder: Store before you spend; roots grow in the quiet seasons.
en.acting: Put one storing act into today: the early night, the untouched hour, the meal eaten sitting down.

zh_hant.plain: 你花費自己的速度比恢復快，赤字開始顯出來了。
zh_hant.story:
治理人、事奉天，沒有比嗇更好的。嗇就是早準備；早準備就是累積德；累積的德，就沒有克服不了的；然後不知道極限，就能有國；有了國的母親，就能長久。這叫深根固柢，長生久視的道。

這裡的嗇不是關於錢，或不只是。它是關於花費自己：注意力、脾氣、睡眠的鐘點。在這些上面跑赤字的人，正在做這一章警告的事，先花再存。藥方無聊而有效：早存。困難的一週之前的睡眠，不是之後。忙碌的晚上之前的安靜晚上。深根長在看起來什麼都沒發生的季節裡，而風來的時候，撐住莖的就是它們。
zh_hant.reminder: 先存再花；根在安靜的季節裡長。
zh_hant.acting: 把一個「存」的動作放進今天：早睡、不碰的一小時、坐下來吃的一頓飯。

zh_hans.plain: 你花费自己的速度比恢复快，赤字开始显出来了。
zh_hans.story:
治理人、事奉天，没有比啬更好的。啬就是早准备；早准备就是累积德；累积的德，就没有克服不了的；然后不知道极限，就能有国；有了国的母亲，就能长久。这叫深根固柢，长生久视的道。

这里的啬不是关于钱，或不只是。它是关于花费自己：注意力、脾气、睡眠的钟点。在这些上面跑赤字的人，正在做这一章警告的事，先花再存。药方无聊而有效：早存。困难的一周之前的睡眠，不是之后。忙碌的晚上之前的安静晚上。深根长在看起来什么都没发生的季节里，而风来的时候，撑住茎的就是它们。
zh_hans.reminder: 先存再花；根在安静的季节里长。
zh_hans.acting: 把一个「存」的动作放进今天：早睡、不碰的一小时、坐下来吃的一顿饭。

lines: 非其鬼不神其神不傷人
非其神不傷人聖人亦不傷人
夫兩不相傷故德交歸焉
chapters.translation_en:
Governing a great state is like cooking small fish.
Let the kingdom be governed according to the Tao, and the manes of the departed will not manifest their spiritual energy. It is not that those manes have not that spiritual energy, but it will not be employed to hurt men. It is not that it could not hurt men, but neither does the ruling sage hurt them.
When these two do not injuriously affect each other, their good influences converge in the virtue (of the Tao).

en.plain: You are new in charge of something, a team, a project, a household, and you are tempted to change everything at once.
en.story:
Governing a large state is like cooking a small fish. Approach the world with the way and the spirits lose their power; not that they have no power, but it does no harm; and as their power harms no one, the sage harms no one either; and when neither harms, virtue flows back and forth between them.

A small fish falls apart if it is turned too often. The chapter's whole advice on being in charge is in that image: touch it less than you want to. New authority brings an itch to change everything, to prove the change of hands, and the fish comes apart. The second half is a promise: handled lightly, things that seemed like threats lose their sting without a fight, and what flows back is goodwill. Change one thing. Let it cook.
en.reminder: Cook the small fish; turn it less than you want to.
en.acting: Make one change this week in the thing you now run, and leave everything else as you found it.

zh_hant.plain: 你剛接手一樣東西，一個團隊、一個案子、一個家，很想一次全部改掉。
zh_hant.story:
治大國，像煎小魚。用道面對天下，鬼神就失去力量；不是沒有力量，而是不害人；它的力量不害人，聖人也不害人；兩邊都不害，德就在兩邊之間來回。

小魚翻太多次會散掉。這一章關於「當家」的全部建議都在這個畫面裡：碰它，少於你想碰的次數。新的權力帶來一種癢，想全部改掉，證明換了人，於是魚散了。後半是一個承諾：輕輕地處理，看起來像威脅的東西不用打就失去了刺，回流的是善意。改一件事。讓它煎。
zh_hant.reminder: 煎小魚；翻的次數少於你想翻的。
zh_hant.acting: 這星期在你剛接手的東西裡改一件事，其餘的照你接手時的樣子留著。

zh_hans.plain: 你刚接手一样东西，一个团队、一个案子、一个家，很想一次全部改掉。
zh_hans.story:
治大国，像煎小鱼。用道面对天下，鬼神就失去力量；不是没有力量，而是不害人；它的力量不害人，圣人也不害人；两边都不害，德就在两边之间来回。

小鱼翻太多次会散掉。这一章关于「当家」的全部建议都在这个画面里：碰它，少于你想碰的次数。新的权力带来一种痒，想全部改掉，证明换了人，于是鱼散了。后半是一个承诺：轻轻地处理，看起来像威胁的东西不用打就失去了刺，回流的是善意。改一件事。让它煎。
zh_hans.reminder: 煎小鱼；翻的次数少于你想翻的。
zh_hans.acting: 这星期在你刚接手的东西里改一件事，其余的照你接手时的样子留着。

lines: 牝常以靜勝牡以靜為下
小國以下大國則取大國
chapters.translation_en:
What makes a great state is its being (like) a low-lying, down-flowing (stream);--it becomes the centre to which tend (all the small states) under heaven. (To illustrate from) the case of all females:--the female always overcomes the male by her stillness. Stillness may be considered (a sort of) abasement.
Thus it is that a great state, by condescending to small states, gains them for itself; and that small states, by abasing themselves to a great state, win it over to them. In the one case the abasement leads to gaining adherents, in the other case to procuring favour.
The great state only wishes to unite men together and nourish them; a small state only wishes to be received by, and to serve, the other.
Each gets what it desires, but the great state must learn to abase itself.

en.plain: You are the one with more, more money, more standing, more room, in a relationship where that has started to cause friction.
en.story:
A great state is like the low ground where rivers meet, the female of the world, who by stillness overcomes the male, and lies low. So a great state, by placing itself below a small one, wins it; a small state, by placing itself below a great one, is won. One gains by lowering itself, the other by being low. Both get what they want, and the great should be the one to lower itself.

The chapter is diplomacy, and it applies wherever there is an imbalance: the sibling who earns more, the partner with the steadier job, the friend with the bigger flat. Laozi's rule is simple and often reversed in practice: the one with more should be the one to go low. Not by pretending to have less, which insults everyone, but by taking the receiving position: asking, listening, letting the other carry something. The friction comes from the larger one standing tall. The relationship comes back when the larger one sits down.
en.reminder: The one with more goes low first.
en.acting: Ask the person with less to do one thing for you this week, and accept it without evening the score.

zh_hant.plain: 你是那個擁有比較多的人，錢、地位、空間，在一段關係裡，這已經開始造成摩擦。
zh_hant.story:
大國像河流會合的低處，是天下的雌，用靜勝過雄，而且居下。所以大國把自己放在小國之下，就贏得小國；小國把自己放在大國之下，就被大國接納。一個靠放低自己而得到，一個靠本來就低而得到。兩邊都得到想要的，而大的那一邊該是先放低的。

這一章是外交，凡有不對等的地方都用得上：賺得多的手足，工作穩定的伴侶，房子大的朋友。老子的規矩簡單，實際上卻常被反過來：擁有比較多的人，該是先放低的那一個。不是假裝擁有得少，那是侮辱所有人；而是站到接受的位置：問，聽，讓對方扛一點什麼。摩擦來自大的那一邊站得高。大的那一邊坐下來，關係就回來了。
zh_hant.reminder: 擁有比較多的那一邊，先放低。
zh_hant.acting: 這星期請那個擁有比較少的人為你做一件事，接受它，不去扯平。

zh_hans.plain: 你是那个拥有比较多的人，钱、地位、空间，在一段关系里，这已经开始造成摩擦。
zh_hans.story:
大国像河流会合的低处，是天下的雌，用静胜过雄，而且居下。所以大国把自己放在小国之下，就赢得小国；小国把自己放在大国之下，就被大国接纳。一个靠放低自己而得到，一个靠本来就低而得到。两边都得到想要的，而大的那一边该是先放低的。

这一章是外交，凡有不对等的地方都用得上：赚得多的手足，工作稳定的伴侣，房子大的朋友。老子的规矩简单，实际上却常被反过来：拥有比较多的人，该是先放低的那一个。不是假装拥有得少，那是侮辱所有人；而是站到接受的位置：问，听，让对方扛一点什么。摩擦来自大的那一边站得高。大的那一边坐下来，关系就回来了。
zh_hans.reminder: 拥有比较多的那一边，先放低。
zh_hans.acting: 这星期请那个拥有比较少的人为你做一件事，接受它，不去扯平。

lines: 美言可以市尊行可以加人
不曰以求得有罪以免邪
chapters.translation_en:
Tao has of all things the most honoured place.
 No treasures give good men so rich a grace;
 Bad men it guards, and doth their ill efface. (Its) admirable words can purchase honour; (its) admirable deeds can raise their performer above others. Even men who are not good are not abandoned by it.
Therefore when the sovereign occupies his place as the Son of
Heaven, and he has appointed his three ducal ministers, though (a prince) were to send in a round symbol-of-rank large enough to fill both the hands, and that as the precursor of the team of horses (in the court-yard), such an offering would not be equal to (a lesson of) this Tao, which one might present on his knees.
Why was it that the ancients prized this Tao so much? Was it not because it could be got by seeking for it, and the guilty could escape (from the stain of their guilt) by it? This is the reason why all under heaven consider it the most valuable thing.

en.plain: You made a real mistake, at work or at home, and you are bracing to be cast out for it.
en.story:
The way is the shelter of all things: the treasure of the good and the refuge of the not-good. Fine words can buy honour, fine deeds can raise a person, but the not-good among people, why abandon them? So when an emperor is enthroned and ministers installed, better than jade and four horses is to offer the way, sitting still. Why did the ancients prize it? Because by it the seeker finds and the offender is spared. So it is the world's most precious thing.

The chapter is written for the person who has done wrong, and its tone is protective. Why abandon them? The offender is spared. This is not indifference to the mistake; it is the observation that the way keeps the door open, and that a person bracing for exile is usually bracing against something that is not going to happen. What is going to happen is the repair, and the repair is easier to make from inside the door than from outside it. Stay. Fix what can be fixed.
en.reminder: The door stays open; make the repair from inside it.
en.acting: Name the mistake plainly to the person it affected, and propose the repair in the same breath.

zh_hant.plain: 你犯了一個真實的錯，公司裡或家裡，你正繃著身體等著被趕出去。
zh_hant.story:
道是萬物的庇護：善人的寶，不善人的依靠。好聽的話可以買到尊敬，好的行為可以抬高一個人，但人裡面不善的，為什麼要拋棄？所以天子即位、三公就任，與其獻玉璧和駟馬，不如安坐著獻上道。古人為什麼看重它？因為靠它，求的人得到，有罪的人得免。所以它是天下最珍貴的東西。

這一章是為做錯事的人寫的，語氣是保護的。為什麼要拋棄？有罪的人得免。這不是對錯誤無所謂；這是一個觀察：道把門留著，而一個繃著等放逐的人，通常是在對一件不會發生的事繃著。會發生的是修補，而修補從門裡面做，比從門外面做容易。留下來。修得了的，修。
zh_hant.reminder: 門是開著的；從裡面做修補。
zh_hant.acting: 把那個錯平實地告訴受影響的人，同一口氣提出修補的辦法。

zh_hans.plain: 你犯了一个真实的错，公司里或家里，你正绷着身体等着被赶出去。
zh_hans.story:
道是万物的庇护：善人的宝，不善人的依靠。好听的话可以买到尊敬，好的行为可以擡高一个人，但人里面不善的，为什么要抛弃？所以天子即位、三公就任，与其献玉璧和驷马，不如安坐着献上道。古人为什么看重它？因为靠它，求的人得到，有罪的人得免。所以它是天下最珍贵的东西。

这一章是为做错事的人写的，语气是保护的。为什么要抛弃？有罪的人得免。这不是对错误无所谓；这是一个观察：道把门留着，而一个绷着等放逐的人，通常是在对一件不会发生的事绷着。会发生的是修补，而修补从门里面做，比从门外面做容易。留下来。修得了的，修。
zh_hans.reminder: 门是开着的；从里面做修补。
zh_hans.acting: 把那个错平实地告诉受影响的人，同一口气提出修补的办法。

lines: 圖難於其易為大於其細
夫輕諾必寡信多易必多難
chapters.translation_en:
(It is the way of the Tao) to act without (thinking of) acting; to conduct affairs without (feeling the) trouble of them; to taste without discerning any flavour; to consider what is small as great, and a few as many; and to recompense injury with kindness. (The master of it) anticipates things that are difficult while they are easy, and does things that would become great while they are small. All difficult things in the world are sure to arise from a previous state in which they were easy, and all great things from one in which they were small. Therefore the sage, while he never does what is great, is able on that account to accomplish the greatest things.
He who lightly promises is sure to keep but little faith; he who is continually thinking things easy is sure to find them difficult.
Therefore the sage sees difficulty even in what seems easy, and so never has any difficulties.

en.plain: A tax letter, a medical form, a conversation with your landlord: each one is small now and will not stay small.
en.story:
Act without forcing, work without fuss, taste without flavour. Treat the small as great and the few as many; answer resentment with kindness. Plan the difficult while it is easy; do the great while it is small. All difficult things in the world begin as easy ones; all great things begin as small ones. So the sage never does anything great, and so achieves greatness. Light promises mean little trust; treating everything as easy means many difficulties. So the sage treats even the easy as difficult, and therefore has none.

The letters that cause the most dread are the ones that have been on the table for three weeks. The tax question was a form; now it is a form plus a penalty plus a phone queue. None of this is a character flaw. It is how difficulty grows when it is given time. The counter-move is to catch it in its easy form: one form, one reply, one call, before it changes size.
en.reminder: Catch it while it is still one form, one call.
en.acting: Open the letter that has waited longest and do its first easy step now.

zh_hant.plain: 一封稅務通知、一張醫院表格、一次跟房東的談話：每一件現在都小，但不會一直小。
zh_hant.story:
做而不強求，做事而不添亂，嚐而無味。把小當大，把少當多；用德回報怨。難的事趁容易時計畫；大的事趁小時做。天下難的事都從容易開始；大的事都從小開始。所以聖人從不做大事，因此成就大事。輕易的承諾，信用少；把一切當容易，困難多。所以聖人連容易的也當困難來對待，因此沒有困難。

最讓人害怕的信，是在桌上放了三個星期的那幾封。稅務的問題本來是一張表；現在是一張表加一筆罰款加一段電話排隊。這些都不是性格的缺點。這是困難被給了時間之後長大的方式。反著來的一步，是趁它還是容易的樣子時抓住它：一張表、一則回覆、一通電話，在它變大之前。
zh_hant.reminder: 趁它還只是一張表、一通電話的時候接住它。
zh_hant.acting: 打開放最久的那封信，現在就做它第一個容易的步驟。

zh_hans.plain: 一封税务通知、一张医院表格、一次跟房东的谈话：每一件现在都小，但不会一直小。
zh_hans.story:
做而不强求，做事而不添乱，尝而无味。把小当大，把少当多；用德回报怨。难的事趁容易时计划；大的事趁小时做。天下难的事都从容易开始；大的事都从小开始。所以圣人从不做大事，因此成就大事。轻易的承诺，信用少；把一切当容易，困难多。所以圣人连容易的也当困难来对待，因此没有困难。

最让人害怕的信，是在桌上放了三个星期的那几封。税务的问题本来是一张表；现在是一张表加一笔罚款加一段电话排队。这些都不是性格的缺点。这是困难被给了时间之后长大的方式。反着来的一步，是趁它还是容易的样子时抓住它：一张表、一则回复、一通电话，在它变大之前。
zh_hans.reminder: 趁它还只是一张表、一通电话的时候接住它。
zh_hans.acting: 打开放最久的那封信，现在就做它第一个容易的步骤。

lines: 民之從事常於幾成而敗之
以輔萬物之自然而不敢為
chapters.translation_en:
That which is at rest is easily kept hold of; before a thing has given indications of its presence, it is easy to take measures against it; that which is brittle is easily broken; that which is very small is easily dispersed. Action should be taken before a thing has made its appearance; order should be secured before disorder has begun.
The tree which fills the arms grew from the tiniest sprout; the tower of nine storeys rose from a (small) heap of earth; the journey of a thousand li commenced with a single step.
He who acts (with an ulterior purpose) does harm; he who takes hold of a thing (in the same way) loses his hold. The sage does not act (so), and therefore does no harm; he does not lay hold (so), and therefore does not lose his hold. (But) people in their conduct of affairs are constantly ruining them when they are on the eve of success. If they were careful at the end, as (they should be) at the beginning, they would not so ruin them.
Therefore the sage desires what (other men) do not desire, and does not prize things difficult to get; he learns what (other men) do not learn, and turns back to what the multitude of men have passed by.
Thus he helps the natural development of all things, and does not dare to act (with an ulterior purpose of his own).

en.plain: The debt, the degree, the house deposit: the number is so large that starting feels pointless.
en.story:
What is still is easily held; what has not yet shown is easily planned for; the brittle breaks easily; the small scatters easily. Act before it exists; order before it is disordered. A tree you can barely embrace grew from a shoot; a nine-storey tower rose from a basket of earth; a journey of a thousand li began under one's feet. Those who force ruin it; those who grasp lose it. People fail on the verge of success; be as careful at the end as at the beginning, and nothing is ruined.

Big numbers do something to the mind: the whole arrives at once and the body refuses. The chapter separates the whole from the step. The whole is real and stays real.
